works.exercise_en: Use ARKit scene reconstruction to fill a real room's floor with an AR soil layer 50 cm deep that correctly hides furniture legs. Twist: let footprints appear in the soil where people walk.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 场景重建在真实房间地面铺一层 50 厘米深的 AR 泥土，并正确遮住家具腿；变体：人们走过的地方会在泥土中留下脚印。

works.title: The Vertical Earth Kilometer
works.description: For documenta 6 in Kassel, a brass rod one kilometre long was sunk vertically into the ground of Friedrichsplatz; all that can be seen is its end, a small circle flush with a sandstone plate.
works.description_zh: 为卡塞尔文献展第六届，一根长一公里的黄铜棒被垂直埋入 Friedrichsplatz 广场地下；地面上只能看到它的末端，一个与砂岩板齐平的小圆。
works.idea_en: An artwork almost entirely invisible and known only by its description shows that AR can point to things we can never see, such as depth.
works.idea_zh: 一件几乎完全看不见、只能靠描述得知的作品说明，AR 可以指向我们永远看不见的东西，比如深度。
works.technique: A shaft was drilled for 79 days and 167 brass segments were screwed together and lowered into it.
works.technique_zh: 钻井持续 79 天，167 段黄铜棒被逐段拧接后放入井中。
works.exercise_en: Mark a spot on the ground and, in AR, show what lies directly beneath it to one kilometre depth (soil layers, pipes, bedrock) from open geological data. Twist: show nothing but a small circle until the user kneels down.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面标记一个点，在 AR 中根据公开地质数据展示其正下方一公里深处的内容（土层、管道、基岩）；变体：直到用户蹲下之前，只显示一个小圆。

works.title: A Line Made by Walking
works.description: As a student, Long walked back and forth along a straight line in a Wiltshire field until the flattened grass caught the light, then photographed it; the photograph is the work.
works.description_zh: 还是学生时，Long 在威尔特郡的一片田野上沿一条直线来回行走，直到被踩倒的草反射出光线，然后拍下照片；这张照片就是作品。
works.idea_en: The body's repeated path becomes the drawing: the purest form of a location-based trace that AR can record and replay.
works.idea_zh: 身体反复走过的路径本身就是绘画：这是 AR 可以记录和回放的位置轨迹最纯粹的形式。
works.technique: Repeated walking pressed the grass flat along one axis so the line appeared by reflected light, fixed in one photograph.
works.technique_zh: 反复行走把草沿一条轴线压平，使线条通过反射光显现，并被一张照片定格。
works.exercise_en: Walk the same straight line 20 times with a WebXR or AR Foundation app that thickens and brightens an AR line each time you pass. Twist: invite others to walk it too, and let the line fade if nobody walks for a day.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 应用沿同一直线走 20 次，每走一次 AR 线就变粗变亮；变体：邀请其他人一起走，如果一天无人行走，线就会淡去。

works.title: Stones and Flies: Richard Long in the Sahara
works.description: Philip Haas's film follows Long across the Sahara as he walks, arranges stones into lines and circles, and draws in the sand, leaving marks the wind will erase.
works.description_zh: Philip Haas 的影片跟随 Long 穿越撒哈拉：他行走，把石头排成直线和圆，在沙上作画，留下终将被风抹去的痕迹。
works.idea_en: Simple geometric marks (line, circle) instantly read as human in a vast landscape, a lesson in how little an AR mark needs.
works.idea_zh: 简单的几何标记（线、圆）在广阔风景中立刻被读作人的痕迹，说明 AR 标记所需其实很少。
works.technique: Long collects stones on the spot and places them in geometric figures, recording each walk with photographs and text.
works.technique_zh: Long 就地收集石块摆成几何图形，并用照片和文字记录每一次行走。
works.exercise_en: Collect ten real stones, scan them with Polycam, and arrange copies in AR into a 20-metre circle on a field. Twist: add one new stone to the circle each time a visitor arrives, until it closes.
works.exercise_zh: 收集十块真实石头，用 Polycam 扫描后，在 AR 中把副本在操场上排成直径 20 米的圆；变体：每来一位访客就往圆里加一块石头，直到圆闭合。

works.title: Richard Long at The Hepworth Wakefield
works.description: Behind the scenes of Long's exhibition at The Hepworth Wakefield: stones laid out in large floor works and mud applied by hand directly to the walls.
works.description_zh: Long 在 Hepworth Wakefield 美术馆展览的幕后：石块在地面上铺成大型作品，泥浆被直接用手涂抹在墙上。
works.idea_en: Bringing a walk's materials indoors as a precise floor pattern shows how an outdoor trace can be translated into a room-scale layout, as AR can do.
works.idea_zh: 把行走中的材料带入室内，铺成精确的地面图案，说明户外轨迹可以转译成房间尺度的布局，AR 也能这样做。
works.technique: Stones are sorted and placed by hand following a simple geometry, and mud is applied to walls with the hands in rhythmic strokes.
works.technique_zh: 石块按简单几何手工分类摆放，泥浆则用手有节奏地抹到墙上。
works.exercise_en: Record a walk outdoors as a GPS track, then in a classroom lay it out at room scale in AR as a line of stones on the floor. Twist: add muddy hand-prints on the real walls in AR at the points where you stopped.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外把一次行走记录为 GPS 轨迹，然后在教室里用 AR 按房间尺度把它铺成地面上的一列石头；变体：在你停下的位置，用 AR 在真实墙面上印上泥手印。

works.title: City
works.description: Begun in 1970 and opened in 2022, City is a complex of compacted-earth mounds, ramps and concrete forms about 2.4 kilometres long in a remote Nevada valley; only six visitors a day are admitted.
works.description_zh: 《City》始于 1970 年、2022 年开放，是内华达偏远山谷中长约 2.4 公里、由夯土丘、坡道和混凝土构件组成的建筑群；每天只接待六名访客。
works.idea_en: A walkable abstract architecture in the desert shows how pure geometry at huge scale can feel like a lost civilisation, a mood AR world-builders chase.
works.idea_zh: 沙漠中可以行走的抽象建筑说明，巨大尺度的纯几何能让人感觉像失落的文明，这是 AR 世界构建者追求的氛围。
works.technique: Earth from the site was excavated, compacted and shaped with heavy machinery into mounds and depressions, edged with concrete.
works.technique_zh: 用重型机械把场地的泥土挖出、压实并塑成土丘与凹地，边缘以混凝土收边。
works.exercise_en: Model a large geometric complex (ramps, mounds, sunken courts) in Blender and place it at 1:1 scale on a sports field in AR. Twist: allow only one viewer at a time, so each visit feels solitary.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 中建模一个大型几何建筑群（坡道、土丘、下沉庭院），在 AR 中按 1:1 比例放在运动场上；变体：一次只允许一位观者进入，让每次参观都显得孤独。

works.title: Levitated Mass
works.description: A 340-ton granite boulder sits on two ledges above a 139-metre concrete slot at LACMA in Los Angeles; visitors walk down the ramp and pass underneath it.
works.description_zh: 一块重 340 吨的花岗岩巨石架在洛杉矶郡立艺术博物馆一条长 139 米的混凝土沟槽上方的两处支座上；观众沿坡道走下去，从它下面经过。
works.idea_en: Walking under something heavy that seems to float creates real bodily tension, a cue AR can borrow with carefully scaled overhead objects.
works.idea_zh: 从一个看似漂浮的重物下面走过会产生真实的身体紧张感，AR 可以用尺度精确的头顶物体借用这种感觉。
works.technique: The boulder was moved 170 kilometres over 11 nights on a custom transporter and bolted onto steel shelves over the slot.
works.technique_zh: 巨石用特制运输车历时 11 个夜晚移动了 170 公里，再用螺栓固定在沟槽上方的钢托架上。
works.exercise_en: Place a photoreal AR boulder over a real corridor or doorway so people must walk under it, and add a faint rumble sound as they pass. Twist: the boulder rises a little higher for each person who walks under it.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实走廊或门口上方放置一块逼真的 AR 巨石，让人们必须从它下面走过，经过时加入低沉的隆隆声；变体：每有一个人从下面走过，巨石就升高一点。

works.title: Double Negative
works.description: Two trenches, each about 9 metres wide and 15 metres deep, are cut into facing edges of the Mormon Mesa in Nevada; the sculpture is the empty space between them.
works.description_zh: 两条各约 9 米宽、15 米深的沟槽切入内华达摩门台地相对的两侧边缘；雕塑就是两者之间的空。
works.idea_en: A sculpture made of removed material shows that absence can be the object, a direct idea for diminished-reality AR.
works.idea_zh: 由被移除的材料构成的雕塑说明，缺失本身可以是作品，这是“削减现实”AR 的直接创意。
works.technique: About 244,000 tons of rhyolite and sandstone were blasted and bulldozed out of the mesa edge.
works.technique_zh: 约 24.4 万吨流纹岩和砂岩从台地边缘被炸开并推走。
works.exercise_en: Use a depth mask to cut a deep virtual trench into a real floor or lawn in AR so users seem to look down into it. Twist: align two trenches so they read as one line only from a single spot.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度遮罩在 AR 中给真实地面或草坪“切”出一条深沟，让用户仿佛往下看；变体：对齐两条沟，让它们只在某一个位置看起来连成一条线。

works.title: Star Axis
works.description: Under construction since 1971 on a New Mexico mesa, Star Axis is a naked-eye observatory: a stairway aligned with Earth's axis lets you see Polaris framed by a circle whose size changes with the 26,000-year precession of the axis.
works.description_zh: 自 1971 年起在新墨西哥台地上建造的《Star Axis》是一座肉眼天文台：一条与地轴平行的阶梯让人看到北极星被一个圆框住，圆的大小随地轴 26000 年一周的岁差而变化。
works.idea_en: Each step up the stair corresponds to a moment in the precession cycle, so walking becomes time travel through astronomy, a strong model for data-bound AR paths.
works.idea_zh: 阶梯的每一级对应岁差周期中的一个时刻，行走于是成为穿越天文时间的旅行，这是绑定数据的 AR 路径的有力范本。
works.technique: An 11-storey Star Tunnel is cut into the mesa along the axis of the Earth, with its aperture sized to track Polaris's apparent circle over millennia.
works.technique_zh: 一条 11 层楼高的“星隧道”沿地轴方向切入台地，开口大小经过设计，用以追踪北极星在数千年中视运动的圆。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR staircase aligned with your latitude's polar axis that shows, at each step, where Polaris will appear in a different century. Twist: let the user walk down to go back in time.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建一个与当地纬度极轴对齐的 AR 阶梯，每一级显示北极星在不同世纪的位置；变体：让用户往下走即可回到过去。

works.title: Storm King Wavefield
works.description: On a former gravel pit at Storm King Art Center, seven rows of grass-covered earth waves, up to 4.5 metres tall, roll across 4.4 hectares; walking into them, you lose sight of everything but the next wave.
works.description_zh: 在 Storm King 艺术中心的一处旧砾石坑上，七排覆草土浪高达 4.5 米，起伏铺满 4.4 公顷；走进其中，你只能看见下一道浪。
works.idea_en: A frozen water pattern made of earth lets people 'swim' with their bodies, a model for AR terrain that users walk through rather than look at.
works.idea_zh: 用泥土凝固的水波让人用身体去“游”，是让用户穿行其中而非仅仅观看的 AR 地形范本。
works.technique: Earth was shaped into sine-like waves based on the pattern of water waves, then grassed over.
works.technique_zh: 依据水波纹样把泥土塑造成近似正弦波的形状，再覆以草皮。
works.exercise_en: Generate an AR field of sine-wave ridges 1–2 metres high on a flat lawn with a height shader, and walk through it. Twist: let the waves slowly travel in the direction of the real wind.
works.exercise_zh: 用高度着色器在平坦草坪上生成一片 1–2 米高的正弦波 AR 土浪并在其中行走；变体：让波浪沿真实风向缓缓移动。

works.title: Ghost Forest
works.description: Forty-nine dead Atlantic white cedars, killed by saltwater from rising seas in New Jersey, stand in a grove in Madison Square Park, with a soundscape of animal calls from species once native to Manhattan.
works.description_zh: 49 棵因海平面上升导致海水倒灌而死亡的新泽西大西洋白雪松被立成一片树林，置于麦迪逊广场公园，并配有曾原生于曼哈顿的物种的叫声。
works.idea_en: Bringing the evidence of climate change into a busy park makes a distant event physical, a direct brief for climate-data AR.
works.idea_zh: 把气候变化的证据带进繁忙的公园，让遥远的事件变得具体可触，这是气候数据 AR 的直接命题。
works.technique: Salvaged trees were transported and set upright in the park; an audio piece plays through a phone link for visitors.
works.technique_zh: 回收的枯树被运来竖立在公园中；观众可以通过手机链接收听一段音频作品。
works.exercise_en: Place a grove of grey AR trees in a school courtyard and attach sounds of species that lived there 200 years ago (from local records). Twist: the grove grows by one dead tree for every centimetre of projected sea-level rise.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园庭院里放置一片灰色 AR 树林，并配上 200 年前曾生活在那里的物种的声音（取自当地记录）；变体：预计海平面每上升一厘米，树林就多一棵枯树。

works.title: Vietnam Veterans Memorial
works.description: Two black granite walls cut into the ground of the National Mall in Washington meet in a V, engraved with the names of more than 58,000 Americans killed in the Vietnam War; visitors see their own reflection among the names.
works.description_zh: 两道黑色花岗岩墙切入华盛顿国家广场的地面，交汇成 V 字，刻有 58000 多名在越战中阵亡的美国人的名字；观众会在名字间看到自己的倒影。
works.idea_en: Reflection puts the living among the names, and the wall grows taller as you walk in, a model for data AR that uses the viewer's body and path.
works.idea_zh: 倒影让生者置身于名字之间，墙也随你走入而逐渐升高，这是利用观者身体和路径的数据 AR 范本。
works.technique: The wall is set into a cut in the earth that deepens toward the apex; names are listed chronologically by date of death.
works.technique_zh: 墙体嵌在一道向顶点逐渐加深的地面切口中；名字按阵亡日期的时间顺序排列。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR wall that rises from the ground as the user walks along it and lists a dataset (for example, species lost in your region) in chronological order, with a mirror material. Twist: the names nearest the user's reflection become readable aloud.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一面随用户沿其行走而从地面升起的 AR 墙，按时间顺序列出一个数据集（例如本地区消失的物种），并使用镜面材质；变体：离用户倒影最近的名字会被朗读出来。

works.title: Wheatfield – A Confrontation
works.description: On a landfill two blocks from Wall Street, Denes planted and harvested two acres of golden wheat against the backdrop of the World Trade Center towers.
works.description_zh: 在距华尔街两个街区的一片垃圾填埋地上，Denes 以世界贸易中心双塔为背景，种植并收割了两英亩金黄的小麦。
works.idea_en: A living field in the wrong place is a sharp confrontation of values, a template for AR that plants nature where it 'should not' be.
works.idea_zh: 一片出现在“错误地点”的活麦田是对价值观的尖锐对峙，是把自然种在“不该出现之处”的 AR 模板。
works.technique: About 200 truckloads of soil were brought onto the rubble; wheat was sown by hand, irrigated and harvested four months later.
works.technique_zh: 约 200 卡车泥土被运到瓦砾上；小麦由人工播种、灌溉，四个月后收割。
works.exercise_en: Cover a car park or a financial-district plaza with a waving AR wheat field that responds to device tilt as wind. Twist: the field's height tracks a live commodity price for wheat.
works.exercise_zh: 用一片随设备倾斜如风般摇曳的 AR 麦田覆盖一个停车场或金融区广场；变体：麦田高度跟随实时小麦商品价格变化。

works.title: Tree Mountain – A Living Time Capsule
works.description: In Ylöjärvi, Finland, 11,000 fir trees were planted by 11,000 people on a man-made mountain in a pattern derived from the golden ratio; each planter was given custodianship of a tree for 400 years.
works.description_zh: 在芬兰伊勒耶尔维，11000 人在一座人造山上按照源自黄金比例的图案种下 11000 棵冷杉；每位种树者都被授予一棵树 400 年的监护权。
works.idea_en: One person, one tree, one position in a pattern: a shared artwork that lasts centuries, a model for persistent multi-user AR.
works.idea_zh: 一人、一树、图案中的一个位置：一件延续数百年的共享作品，是持久多人 AR 的范本。
works.technique: Tree positions follow a spiral pattern inspired by pineapple and sunflower phyllotaxis, laid out on a reshaped gravel pit.
works.technique_zh: 树木位置依照受菠萝和向日葵叶序启发的螺旋图案，布置在重新塑形的砾石坑上。
works.exercise_en: Lay out a Fibonacci spiral of AR saplings on a lawn and let each classmate claim one with their name, stored in a shared database. Twist: saplings grow only on days their owner visits.
works.exercise_zh: 在草坪上按斐波那契螺旋布置 AR 树苗，让每位同学认领一棵并写上名字，存入共享数据库；变体：树苗只在主人到访的那天生长。

works.title: The Living Pyramid
works.description: At Desert X 2025 in the Coachella Valley, a terraced earth pyramid is planted with native desert flowers and grasses, a new version of Denes's living pyramids first grown in New York and Luxembourg.
works.description_zh: 在 2025 年科切拉谷的 Desert X 展上，一座阶梯状土金字塔种满原生沙漠花草，是 Denes 在纽约和卢森堡种过的“活金字塔”的新版本。
works.idea_en: A monumental shape made of living plants changes with the seasons, showing how an AR form can have a growing skin.
works.idea_zh: 由活植物构成的纪念性形体随季节而变，说明 AR 形体可以有一层会生长的“皮肤”。
works.technique: An earth pyramid is built in stepped terraces, each planted with species chosen to bloom at different times.
works.technique_zh: 土金字塔分层筑成台阶，每层种植花期不同的物种。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR pyramid of terraces on a plaza and let its planting change by month using a list of local native plants. Twist: visitors water a terrace with a tap gesture, and it blooms early.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放一座阶梯状 AR 金字塔，根据本地原生植物列表让其种植随月份变化；变体：访客用点按手势给某一层浇水，它就会提前开花。

works.title: Horizon Line Chamber
works.description: A stone chamber on the shore of Morecambe Bay works as a camera obscura: inside the dark room, a lens projects the moving sea, sky and horizon upside down onto the walls.
works.description_zh: 莫克姆湾岸边的一座石室就是一个暗箱：在黑暗的室内，透镜把移动的海、天和地平线倒着投到墙上。
works.idea_en: A dark room that shows the outside world live is the ancestor of AR passthrough: it reframes a familiar view by changing how it is delivered.
works.idea_zh: 一间实时呈现外部世界的暗室是 AR 视频透视的祖先：它通过改变呈现方式来重新框定熟悉的景色。
works.technique: A lens and mirror set into the roof or wall project the exterior view onto the interior surfaces; no electricity is used.
works.technique_zh: 安装在屋顶或墙上的透镜与镜子把外景投射到室内表面，全程不用电。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard camera obscura, then build the digital version: a phone app that flips the live camera upside down and projects it onto a wall with a pico projector. Twist: delay the image by one minute so people meet their past selves.
works.exercise_zh: 先做一个纸板暗箱，再做它的数字版：一个把实时画面上下翻转的手机应用，用微型投影仪投到墙上；变体：把画面延迟一分钟，让人们遇见过去的自己。

works.title: Carbon Sink: What Goes Around, Comes Around
works.description: At the University of Wyoming, a 11-metre spiral of beetle-killed pine logs and lumps of coal made a direct link between fossil fuels, a warming climate and dying forests; it was removed after protests from the coal industry.
works.description_zh: 在怀俄明大学，一个直径 11 米、由被甲虫害死的松木和煤块组成的螺旋，把化石燃料、气候变暖与森林死亡直接联系起来；在煤炭行业抗议后被拆除。
works.idea_en: A simple spiral of two materials tells a cause-and-effect story; AR data art can be this direct and this local.
works.idea_zh: 由两种材料组成的简单螺旋讲出了因果故事；AR 数据艺术也可以如此直接、如此在地。
works.technique: Logs from local forests killed by pine beetles were arranged in a whirlpool with coal at its centre.
works.technique_zh: 来自当地被松甲虫害死的森林的原木被排成漩涡状，中心是煤块。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR spiral on campus from two scanned materials that stand for a local cause and effect (for example, cars and dead trees). Twist: tie the spiral's size to today's local air-quality index.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里用两种扫描材料搭建一个 AR 螺旋，分别代表本地的因与果（例如汽车与枯树）；变体：让螺旋大小与当天本地空气质量指数挂钩。

works.title: Installations at Montalvo Arts Center
works.description: At Montalvo Arts Center in California, Drury builds works that mirror natural patterns, including a woven structure up in the trees, and explains how his work follows the hidden patterns of nature.
works.description_zh: 在加州 Montalvo 艺术中心，Drury 创作了呼应自然纹样的作品，包括在树上编织的结构，并讲述他的作品如何追随自然中隐藏的纹样。
works.idea_en: Echoing a pattern you find in nature (veins, rivers, whirlpools) at a new scale makes the hidden structure visible, a strategy for AR generative forms.
works.idea_zh: 把在自然中发现的纹样（叶脉、河流、漩涡）以新的尺度复现，让隐藏的结构显形，这是 AR 生成形态的一种策略。
works.technique: He weaves branches and builds chambers on site, likely referencing drawn patterns of water flow and blood vessels.
works.technique_zh: 他在现场编织树枝、建造石室，很可能参考了水流与血管的图案。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a leaf's veins, trace them into a 3D path, and grow the pattern at tree scale between real trunks in AR. Twist: make the branches pulse like blood flow when touched.
works.exercise_zh: 拍摄一片叶子的叶脉，把它描成三维路径，在 AR 中把图案以树的尺度生长在真实树干之间；变体：触碰时让枝条像血流一样搏动。

works.title: Mirage
works.description: For Desert X near Palm Springs, a single-storey ranch house is covered inside and out with mirrors, so it reflects the desert and mountains and seems to vanish into them.
works.description_zh: 为棕榈泉附近的 Desert X 展，一座单层牧场式住宅内外都覆满镜面，映出沙漠和群山，仿佛消失在其中。
works.idea_en: A mirrored object is only its surroundings, reframed: a perfect physical reference for environment-reflective AR materials and 'invisible' objects.
works.idea_zh: 镜面物体只是被重新框取的环境：这是环境反射 AR 材质和“隐形”物体的完美实体参考。
works.technique: A timber frame house shape is clad with mirror panels on every surface, including the interior, so views multiply inside.
works.technique_zh: 木框架房屋的每个表面（包括室内）都覆以镜面板，使室内景象层层倍增。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR house with a real-time environment-probe mirror material (ARKit environment texturing) in an open landscape and see how it disappears. Twist: open its door into a mirrored interior that reflects the user infinitely.
works.exercise_zh: 在开阔风景中放置一座使用实时环境探针镜面材质（ARKit 环境纹理）的 AR 房屋，观察它如何消失；变体：打开门进入一个无限反射用户的镜面室内。

works.title: Mirage Gstaad
works.description: For Elevation 1049 in Gstaad, Switzerland, the mirrored house moves to a snowy Alpine meadow, where it reflects mountains, snow and sky and changes with every season.
works.description_zh: 为瑞士格施塔德的 Elevation 1049 艺术节，这座镜面房屋来到白雪覆盖的阿尔卑斯草甸，映照群山、积雪和天空，并随季节而变。
works.idea_en: The same object in a new landscape becomes a new work, which shows why AR assets should be designed to take on the character of each site.
works.idea_zh: 同一件物体换到新的风景中就成了新作品，说明 AR 资产应当被设计成能吸收每个场地的特质。
works.technique: The mirror-clad structure was rebuilt on a mountain site and left through winter and summer so the reflected landscape transforms it.
works.technique_zh: 镜面结构在山区场地上重建，历经冬夏，让反射的风景不断改变它。
works.exercise_en: Use the same mirrored AR object in three different outdoor places (park, street, rooftop) and record how each site changes it. Twist: let the object keep a faint memory texture of the last place it was placed.
works.exercise_zh: 把同一个镜面 AR 物体放在三个不同的户外地点（公园、街道、屋顶），记录每个场地如何改变它；变体：让物体保留上一次放置地点的淡淡“记忆”纹理。

works.title: Underwater Pavilions
works.description: Off Catalina Island, three geodesic sculptures with mirrored and rough surfaces are anchored under the sea; divers swim through them as the reflections of fish and water shift.
works.description_zh: 在卡塔利娜岛外海，三件带有镜面和粗糙表面的网格球体雕塑被锚定在海下；潜水者穿行其间，鱼群和海水的倒影不断变化。
works.idea_en: A sculpture you can only visit by entering another element (water) shows how an AR piece can require a special trip or state to be seen.
works.idea_zh: 只有进入另一种介质（水）才能拜访的雕塑说明，AR 作品可以要求一段特殊的旅程或状态才能被看到。
works.technique: Faceted structures of mirror and textured panels were moored to the sea floor at depths reachable by recreational divers.
works.technique_zh: 由镜面与纹理面板构成的多面体结构被系泊在休闲潜水者可到达的海底深度。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR piece that only appears when the phone is inside a clear bag in a pool or bathtub (detected by camera blur or a colour cue). Twist: the piece reflects any fish or swimmers passing by.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一件只有当手机装在透明袋中、处于泳池或浴缸水下时才出现的 AR 作品（通过相机模糊或色彩线索检测）；变体：作品会反射经过的鱼或游泳者。

works.title: New Horizon
works.description: A 30-metre mirrored hot-air balloon travelled across Massachusetts, rising at dawn and dusk to reflect the sky and land, with talks and music at each stop.
works.description_zh: 一只高 30 米的镜面热气球巡游马萨诸塞州，在黎明和黄昏升空，映照天空与大地，每一站都伴有讲座和音乐。
works.idea_en: A reflective object in the sky becomes a gathering point for a community, showing how a shared AR landmark can structure an event.
works.idea_zh: 天空中的反光物体成为社区聚集的焦点，说明共享的 AR 地标可以组织一场活动。
works.technique: A hot-air balloon envelope made of reflective fabric flies tethered and in free flight, lit at night from within.
works.technique_zh: 由反光织物制成的热气球球囊进行系留和自由飞行，夜间由内部照亮。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a large reflective AR sphere in the sky above a school event and let everybody's phone show the same sphere with synchronised lighting. Twist: the sphere rises higher as more people look at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校活动上空锚定一个巨大的反光 AR 球体，让所有人的手机看到同一个球体并同步灯光；变体：看它的人越多，它升得越高。

works.title: Aerocene
works.description: Aerocene is an open community project of balloon sculptures that float using only the heat of the sun and the air, without burning fuel or using helium; the Art21 film shows launches and Saraceno's studio.
works.description_zh: Aerocene 是一个开放的社群项目：气球雕塑只靠太阳和空气的热量漂浮，不燃烧燃料也不使用氦气；Art21 的影片展示了放飞现场和 Saraceno 的工作室。
works.idea_en: A shared, open tool for flying without fuel turns the sky into a commons, a frame for collaborative AR in the air.
works.idea_zh: 一个无需燃料即可飞行的共享开放工具，把天空变成了公共领域，这为空中协作 AR 提供了框架。
works.technique: Lightweight, dark-coloured envelopes absorb sunlight so the air inside warms and becomes lighter than the surrounding air.
works.technique_zh: 轻质深色的球囊吸收阳光，使内部空气升温变轻，比周围空气更轻而上升。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR balloon whose lift is driven by live solar irradiance data for your location, and launch it together with classmates. Twist: every balloon's flight path is saved and drawn as a trail over the city for the next group.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 AR 气球，其升力由当地实时太阳辐照数据驱动，与同学一起放飞；变体：保存每只气球的飞行路径，并作为轨迹画在城市上空给下一组人看。

works.title: Fly with Aerocene Pacha
works.description: Over the Salinas Grandes salt flats in Argentina, Leticia Marqués made the world's most sustainable manned flight, lifted only by the sun in the Aerocene Pacha balloon, carrying the message 'Water and life are worth more than lithium'.
works.description_zh: 在阿根廷萨利纳斯格兰德盐沼上空，Leticia Marqués 乘坐仅靠太阳升空的 Aerocene Pacha 气球完成了世界上最可持续的载人飞行，气球上写着“水与生命比锂更珍贵”。
works.idea_en: A human lifted by the sun over a threatened landscape links a body, a message and a place, the three things a strong location AR work needs.
works.idea_zh: 一个被太阳托起、飞越受威胁风景的人，把身体、信息和地点联系在一起，这正是一件有力的位置 AR 作品所需的三要素。
works.technique: A large black solar balloon heats up in the sun and rises with a pilot; the flight set records for solar-only lighter-than-air flight.
works.technique_zh: 大型黑色太阳能气球在阳光下升温，载着飞行员升空；这次飞行创下了纯太阳能轻于空气飞行的纪录。
works.exercise_en: Stage an AR balloon launch on a real landscape under threat (a river, a green space) that carries a user-written message readable from below. Twist: the balloon only rises on sunny days.
works.exercise_zh: 在一处真实的受威胁风景（河流、绿地）上举行一次 AR 气球放飞，气球带着用户写下、从下方可读的信息；变体：气球只在晴天升起。

works.title: Poetic Cosmos of the Breath
works.description: A large balloon sewn from plastic bags rose over a field in the UK, heated only by the sun, as an early step toward Saraceno's ideas of floating cities.
works.description_zh: 一个用塑料袋缝制的大气球只靠阳光加热，在英国的一片田野上空升起，是 Saraceno“漂浮城市”构想的早期一步。
works.idea_en: Everyday waste turned into a flying object shows how humble materials can carry big visions, an attitude useful for low-tech AR prototypes.
works.idea_zh: 把日常废弃物变成飞行物，说明朴素的材料也能承载宏大的愿景，这种态度对低技术 AR 原型很有用。
works.technique: Plastic bags were taped together into a huge envelope; black bags absorb heat so the air inside becomes buoyant.
works.technique_zh: 塑料袋被胶带拼接成巨大的球囊；黑色袋子吸热，使内部空气产生浮力。
works.exercise_en: Scan crumpled plastic bags and use them as the texture of a huge AR balloon floating over the school. Twist: each student adds one 'bag' to the balloon, and it rises only once it has enough.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描揉皱的塑料袋，把它们作为纹理贴在一个漂浮于学校上空的巨大 AR 气球上；变体：每位学生为气球添加一只“袋子”，数量足够后它才会升起。

works.title: in orbit
works.description: A three-level net of steel wire hangs more than 25 metres above the piazza of K21 in Düsseldorf; visitors climb in and feel every other person's movement through the net.
works.description_zh: 一张三层钢丝网悬挂在杜塞尔多夫 K21 美术馆中庭上方 25 米多的高处；观众爬进网中，能通过网感受到每个人的动作。
works.idea_en: A shared surface that transmits everyone's movement makes multiplayer presence physical, a model for shared AR spaces where others' actions are felt.
works.idea_zh: 一个能传递每个人动作的共享表面，让多人在场变得可以触摸，是能感受到他人动作的共享 AR 空间的范本。
works.technique: A tensioned net spans the glass dome of the building, with large PVC spheres suspended in it; the net's vibrations spread from each visitor.
works.technique_zh: 一张张拉的网横跨建筑的玻璃穹顶，网中悬挂着巨大的 PVC 球体；网的振动从每位观众身上扩散出去。
works.exercise_en: Build a shared AR net over a room (Photon or Lightship) where each user's position bends the net and sends ripples to others. Twist: link two rooms so the net carries movements between them.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建一张覆盖房间的共享 AR 网（Photon 或 Lightship），每个用户的位置都会让网下沉并把涟漪传给他人；变体：连接两个房间，让网在两地之间传递动作。

works.title: Cloud Cities
works.description: At Hamburger Bahnhof in Berlin, dozens of polyhedral modules, some walkable, some with plants or mirrors, float in the hall like a cluster of bubbles or a city in the clouds.
works.description_zh: 在柏林汉堡火车站美术馆，数十个多面体模块（有的可以走进去，有的装有植物或镜子）像一簇气泡或云中城市般漂浮在大厅里。
works.idea_en: Clusters of connected cells suggest how an AR city could grow modularly in the air above us.
works.idea_zh: 一簇相互连接的单元暗示了 AR 城市如何在我们头顶的空中模块化生长。
works.technique: Geodesic and polyhedral frames are covered with transparent and reflective films and held by cables.
works.technique_zh: 测地线与多面体框架覆以透明和反射薄膜，由缆绳悬挂。
works.exercise_en: Generate a cluster of connected AR bubbles in a room using a Voronoi or foam algorithm and let users add a new cell by tapping. Twist: cells with more visitors inside grow larger.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Voronoi 或泡沫算法在房间里生成一簇相连的 AR 气泡，让用户点按即可添加新单元；变体：内部访客越多的单元长得越大。

works.title: Ice Watch
works.description: With geologist Minik Rosing, Eliasson placed twelve blocks of free-floating Greenland ice in a clock formation on public squares (Copenhagen, Paris during COP21, London) and let them melt while people touched them.
works.description_zh: Eliasson 与地质学家 Minik Rosing 合作，把十二块从格陵兰海面打捞的浮冰摆成钟面，放在哥本哈根、巴黎（COP21 期间）和伦敦的广场上，任其在人们触摸中融化。
works.idea_en: Touching melting ice makes climate data physical and felt, a lesson for data AR: let people feel the number in their hands.
works.idea_zh: 触摸正在融化的冰让气候数据变得可触可感，这是数据 AR 的一课：让人把数字握在手里。
works.technique: Ice that had calved from the Greenland ice sheet was harvested from a fjord, shipped in refrigerated containers and arranged like a clock face.
works.technique_zh: 从格陵兰冰盖崩解入峡湾的冰被打捞，用冷藏集装箱运输，再摆成钟面形状。
works.exercise_en: Place twelve AR ice blocks in a clock ring on a plaza and melt them in real time according to the day's temperature. Twist: each block shows how much of Greenland's ice is lost in the second it takes to walk around the ring.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上把十二块 AR 冰块摆成钟面，并按当天气温实时融化；变体：每块冰显示走完一圈所需的时间里格陵兰失去了多少冰。

works.title: The New York City Waterfalls
works.description: Four artificial waterfalls, 27 to 37 metres tall, built from exposed scaffolding, poured river water back into New York's East River and harbour for three months.
works.description_zh: 四座高 27 至 37 米、以裸露脚手架搭成的人造瀑布，在三个月里把河水倒回纽约东河与港口。
works.idea_en: Showing the scaffold behind the illusion lets people see both the effect and how it is made, a stance many AR works could adopt.
works.idea_zh: 把幻觉背后的脚手架也展示出来，让人同时看见效果和其制作方式，许多 AR 作品都可以采用这种立场。
works.technique: Pumps lifted river water to the top of each scaffold tower and let it fall in a sheet back into the river.
works.technique_zh: 水泵把河水抽到每座脚手架塔的顶部，再让它以水幕形式落回河中。
works.exercise_en: Add an AR waterfall pouring off the edge of a real building or bridge, rendering the pump and scaffold as a wireframe. Twist: the flow volume follows real-time river gauge data.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的建筑或桥梁边缘加一道倾泻而下的 AR 瀑布，并把水泵和脚手架以线框渲染出来；变体：水流量跟随实时河流水文数据变化。

works.title: Riverbed
works.description: At the Louisiana Museum in Denmark, a whole wing was filled with stones and gravel from Iceland and a stream running through it, so visitors walk a riverbed inside the museum.
works.description_zh: 在丹麦路易斯安那现代艺术博物馆，一整个展厅被来自冰岛的石头和砾石填满，一条溪流从中穿过，观众在博物馆内沿河床行走。
works.idea_en: Replacing a museum's floor with a landscape you have to climb over changes how the body moves, a strong case for full-room AR replacement.
works.idea_zh: 把博物馆地面替换成需要攀爬的风景，改变了身体的移动方式，这是全房间 AR 替换的有力案例。
works.technique: Tonnes of rock were brought in and shaped over the gallery floors, with a pumped stream circulating through the rooms.
works.technique_zh: 数吨岩石被运入并铺在展厅地面上，水泵驱动的溪流在各房间中循环。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit scene reconstruction to replace a corridor floor with an AR riverbed of rocks and flowing water that respects real walls and doorways. Twist: water flows downhill according to the phone's measured floor slope.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 场景重建把走廊地面替换成由岩石和流水组成的 AR 河床，并尊重真实的墙壁和门洞；变体：水依据手机测得的地面坡度向低处流。

works.title: Dream
works.description: A 20-metre white head of a nine-year-old girl with closed eyes rises from the spoil heap of the former Sutton Manor colliery in St Helens, commissioned with ex-miners through Channel 4's Big Art Project.
works.description_zh: 一个 20 米高、双眼紧闭的九岁女孩白色头像从圣海伦斯前萨顿庄园煤矿的矸石山上升起，由前矿工参与、通过 Channel 4 的 Big Art Project 委托创作。
works.idea_en: A calm face on a scarred landscape changes what the place means for a whole town, showing that an AR landmark can carry collective memory.
works.idea_zh: 一张安静的脸放在满是伤痕的土地上，改变了这个地方对整个小镇的意义，说明 AR 地标可以承载集体记忆。
works.technique: A digitally elongated scan of a girl's head was cast in white dolomite-and-concrete sections on a pile foundation.
works.technique_zh: 女孩头部的扫描经过数字拉长，用白云石与混凝土分段浇筑，立在桩基础上。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classmate's face with eyes closed, stretch it vertically by 50% in Blender, and place it 15 metres tall on a hill or rooftop in AR. Twist: the eyes open only when nobody is looking directly at it.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一位同学闭眼的脸，在 Blender 中竖向拉长 50%，在 AR 中把它以 15 米高度放在山丘或屋顶上；变体：只有当没有人直视它时，眼睛才会睁开。

works.title: Crown Fountain
works.description: Two 15-metre glass-brick towers in Chicago's Millennium Park show video faces of a thousand Chicagoans; every few minutes a face purses its lips and water spouts from its mouth onto children playing in the pool.
works.description_zh: 芝加哥千禧公园里两座 15 米高的玻璃砖塔播放着一千位芝加哥市民的面孔视频；每隔几分钟，某张脸会撅起嘴，水从嘴中喷出，落在池中嬉戏的孩子身上。
works.idea_en: A giant face that suddenly does something physical (spits water) creates delight and play, a good cue for AR characters that trigger real-world effects.
works.idea_zh: 一张巨大的脸突然做出一个实体动作（喷水），带来惊喜和游戏，这是让 AR 角色触发现实效果的好提示。
works.technique: LED screens behind glass bricks play filmed portraits; a nozzle at the mouth position is synchronised with the video to release water.
works.technique_zh: 玻璃砖后的 LED 屏播放拍摄的人像；位于嘴部位置的喷嘴与视频同步喷水。
works.exercise_en: Record short face videos of classmates and place them as two huge AR screens facing each other on a plaza; when a face puckers, spawn an AR water jet between them. Twist: trigger the water with the real user's own lip pucker via face tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 录制同学的短面部视频，在广场上做成两块相对的巨大 AR 屏幕；当某张脸撅嘴时，在两屏之间生成 AR 水柱；变体：通过面部追踪，用真实用户自己的撅嘴动作触发喷水。

works.title: Echo
works.description: A 13-metre white head of a young girl with closed eyes, elongated as if seen in a distorting mirror, sat in Madison Square Park, New York, among the office towers.
works.description_zh: 一个 13 米高、双眼紧闭的少女白色头像，被拉长得像是在哈哈镜中所见，坐落在纽约麦迪逊广场公园的写字楼之间。
works.idea_en: A dreaming face among skyscrapers slows the pace of a busy street, showing how an AR figure can set a mood rather than deliver information.
works.idea_zh: 摩天楼之间一张做梦的脸放慢了繁忙街道的节奏，说明 AR 形象可以营造氛围，而不只是传递信息。
works.technique: A 3D scan of a girl's face is stretched digitally, then fabricated in resin and marble dust over a steel frame.
works.technique_zh: 少女面部的 3D 扫描经过数字拉伸，再用树脂与大理石粉覆在钢架上制作完成。
works.exercise_en: Place a large, calm AR face in the busiest spot of your campus and measure (by observation) whether people slow down near it. Twist: the face breathes slowly, synced to the average walking speed of passers-by.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园最繁忙的地方放一张安静的大型 AR 面孔，观察人们靠近时是否会放慢脚步；变体：面孔缓缓呼吸，节奏与路人的平均步速同步。

works.title: Julia
works.description: In Madrid's Plaza de Colón, a 12-metre elongated white head of a girl with closed eyes stands on a plinth once meant for a statue, in front of the city's traffic.
works.description_zh: 在马德里哥伦布广场，一个 12 米高、被拉长的闭眼少女白色头像立在原本为雕像准备的基座上，面对着城市车流。
works.idea_en: Seen from the side, the thin head almost disappears; from the front it fills the square, a lesson in designing AR objects that change with angle.
works.idea_zh: 从侧面看，这颗纤薄的头几乎消失；从正面看，它充满整个广场，这是设计随角度变化的 AR 物体的一课。
works.technique: The portrait is flattened in depth and stretched in height so its profile is very thin, then cast in resin with marble dust.
works.technique_zh: 肖像在深度上被压扁、在高度上被拉长，使侧面极薄，再以树脂和大理石粉浇铸。
works.exercise_en: Model an AR face that is only 10 cm thick but 10 m tall, place it on a plaza, and film how it appears and disappears as you walk around it. Twist: show a different person's face on the back side.
works.exercise_zh: 建模一张只有 10 厘米厚、却有 10 米高的 AR 面孔，放在广场上，拍摄绕行时它如何出现又消失；变体：在背面显示另一个人的脸。

works.title: Behind the Walls
works.description: At Rockefeller Center in New York, a 12-metre white head of a young woman covers her eyes with her hands, a comment on our choice not to see what is around us.
works.description_zh: 在纽约洛克菲勒中心，一个 12 米高的年轻女性白色头像用双手捂住眼睛，暗指我们选择对周围视而不见。
works.idea_en: A giant figure that refuses to look makes viewers aware of their own looking, a strong idea for gaze-aware AR.
works.idea_zh: 一个拒绝观看的巨大形象让观众意识到自己的观看，这是感知视线的 AR 的有力创意。
works.technique: A scanned head and hands are elongated and fabricated in resin with marble dust, mounted in a plaza.
works.technique_zh: 扫描的头部与双手被拉长后用树脂和大理石粉制作，安装在广场上。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR head that covers its eyes whenever the user points the camera straight at it and peeks when the camera looks away. Twist: invite two users, so the head only uncovers its eyes when both look away.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一个巨大的 AR 头像：当用户把相机正对它时它捂住眼睛，相机移开时它偷看；变体：邀请两位用户，只有两人都移开视线时它才露出眼睛。

works.title: Water's Soul
works.description: A 24-metre white head of a girl with a finger to her lips stands on a pier in Newport, Jersey City, facing Manhattan across the Hudson River, as a reminder to protect water.
works.description_zh: 一个 24 米高、手指抵唇的少女白色头像立在泽西城纽波特的码头上，隔着哈德逊河望向曼哈顿，提醒人们保护水资源。
works.idea_en: A 'hush' gesture aimed at a whole skyline speaks to a city at once, a model for AR figures that address a distant view.
works.idea_zh: 一个对着整条天际线的“嘘”的手势同时对整座城市说话，是向远景发声的 AR 形象的范本。
works.technique: A scanned figure is elongated and built in fibreglass and resin on a steel structure on the waterfront.
works.technique_zh: 扫描的人像被拉长，用玻璃钢和树脂在水岸边的钢结构上制作。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR figure on a riverbank or lake edge that makes a gesture toward the opposite shore, and add a soundscape that goes quiet when you face it. Twist: the figure's gesture changes with the live water level of the river.
works.exercise_zh: 在河岸或湖边放置一个面向对岸做手势的巨大 AR 人像，并加入一段当你面对它时就安静下来的声景；变体：人像的手势随河流实时水位而变化。

works.title: Cloud Gate
works.description: A 10-metre, 110-ton mirror-polished steel bean in Chicago's Millennium Park reflects the skyline, the clouds and the crowds walking under its arch, distorting them in its curves.
works.description_zh: 芝加哥千禧公园中一颗高 10 米、重 110 吨的镜面不锈钢“豆子”映出天际线、云朵和在拱下行走的人群，并在曲面中扭曲它们。
works.idea_en: A mirror object puts the public and the city inside the sculpture; people come to see themselves, which is also why AR mirror filters spread.
works.idea_zh: 镜面物体把公众和城市放进雕塑里；人们来这里是为了看见自己，这也是 AR 镜像滤镜传播的原因。
works.technique: 168 stainless steel plates were welded and polished until the seams disappeared, creating a continuous curved mirror.
works.technique_zh: 168 块不锈钢板被焊接并抛光到接缝消失，形成一个连续的曲面镜。
works.exercise_en: Place a large AR blob with a real-time environment-reflection material in a plaza and let friends gather under it to see their distorted reflection. Twist: the blob slowly morphs its shape to exaggerate whoever is closest.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放置一个使用实时环境反射材质的巨大 AR 团块，让朋友们聚在下面看自己扭曲的倒影；变体：团块会慢慢变形，夸张地放大离它最近的人。

works.title: Sky Mirror
works.description: A six-metre concave steel mirror tilted toward the sky brings the clouds down to the ground; one side shows the sky, the other the surroundings upside down. The film shows a version installed at De Pont museum in Tilburg.
works.description_zh: 一面直径六米、朝天倾斜的凹面钢镜把云朵带到地面上：一面映出天空，另一面则是倒转的周围景物。影片展示了在蒂尔堡 De Pont 美术馆安装的版本。
works.idea_en: Bringing the sky down to eye level with a mirror is exactly what an AR portal to the sky can do on a lawn.
works.idea_zh: 用一面镜子把天空带到视线高度，这正是草坪上一个通往天空的 AR 传送门能做的事。
works.technique: A large concave dish of polished stainless steel is tilted on a stand so its focal reflection frames the sky.
works.technique_zh: 一个抛光不锈钢大型凹面盘斜置于支架上，使其焦点反射恰好框住天空。
works.exercise_en: Place a circular AR portal on a lawn that shows the real sky above the user (from the phone's upward camera or a sky map). Twist: tilt the portal to show tomorrow's forecast sky.
works.exercise_zh: 在草坪上放一个圆形 AR 传送门，显示用户头顶的真实天空（来自手机向上的相机或天空贴图）；变体：倾斜传送门即可显示明天预报中的天空。

works.title: Descension
works.description: In Brooklyn Bridge Park, a circular pit of black-dyed water spins into a continuous whirlpool about eight metres across that seems to drain into the ground.
works.description_zh: 在布鲁克林大桥公园，一个圆形深坑中的黑色染水持续旋转成直径约八米的漩涡，仿佛要流入地下。
works.idea_en: A hole that seems to swallow the ground is the physical version of an AR 'portal into the floor' and shows how motion sells depth.
works.idea_zh: 一个仿佛吞噬地面的洞是 AR“地板传送门”的实体版本，也展示了运动如何让深度显得可信。
works.technique: Pumps spin black-dyed water in a round basin fast enough to form a stable vortex whose centre appears bottomless.
works.technique_zh: 水泵驱动圆形水池中的黑色染水快速旋转，形成稳定的漩涡，中心看起来深不见底。
works.exercise_en: Use an AR depth mask to cut a round hole in a real floor and fill it with a spinning black vortex shader. Twist: objects the user drops near it get pulled in.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 深度遮罩在真实地面上切出一个圆洞，并用旋转的黑色漩涡着色器填充；变体：用户丢到附近的物体会被吸进去。

works.title: ArcelorMittal Orbit
works.description: Designed with engineer Cecil Balmond for the London 2012 Olympics, a 114-metre red steel structure loops around itself with a viewing platform and, since 2016, a spiral slide.
works.description_zh: 与工程师 Cecil Balmond 为 2012 年伦敦奥运会共同设计，这座高 114 米的红色钢结构自我缠绕，设有观景平台，2016 年起还加入了螺旋滑梯。
works.idea_en: A tower that twists around itself turns climbing into looping motion, a reference for AR landmarks you move through rather than look at.
works.idea_zh: 一座自我缠绕的塔把攀登变成环绕运动，是那种让人穿行而非仅仅观看的 AR 地标的参考。
works.technique: A continuous looping steel lattice is built around a central core; the structure's irregular curves were computed for stability.
works.technique_zh: 连续缠绕的钢格构围绕中央核心搭建；其不规则曲线经计算以确保稳定。
works.exercise_en: Generate a looping AR ribbon tower with a spline tool and let users ride a camera path along it. Twist: the ribbon's loop count equals the number of people currently in the session.
works.exercise_zh: 用样条工具生成一座环绕的 AR 飘带塔，让用户沿其上的相机路径“骑行”；变体：飘带的环数等于当前会话中的人数。

works.title: Dismemberment, Site 1 (Gibbs Farm)
works.description: At Gibbs Farm in New Zealand, a red membrane 85 metres long is stretched between two steel ellipses across a valley, like a trumpet or a skin laid over the land. The video is a tour of Gibbs Farm that includes it.
works.description_zh: 在新西兰 Gibbs Farm，一张长 85 米的红色膜在一处山谷两端的两个钢椭圆之间张开，像一支小号，或一层覆在土地上的皮肤。视频是包含该作品的 Gibbs Farm 导览。
works.idea_en: A single stretched surface across a valley shows how one bold shape can frame an entire landscape.
works.idea_zh: 一张横跨山谷的张拉面说明，一个大胆的形体就能框住整片风景。
works.technique: A tensioned PVC fabric is stretched between two large steel rings anchored at either end of a gully.
works.technique_zh: 张拉的 PVC 织物绷在沟谷两端锚固的两个巨大钢环之间。
works.exercise_en: Stretch an AR membrane between two real points (trees, lamp posts) using a cloth simulation, and colour it strongly against the landscape. Twist: let users pluck it like a drum to make a low sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用布料模拟在两个真实点（树、路灯）之间拉起一张 AR 薄膜，并用与风景强烈对比的颜色；变体：让用户像拨鼓一样拨动它，发出低沉的声音。

works.title: Vestige
works.description: Six life-size mirrored human figures stand among the trees at the David Marshall Lodge in Aberfoyle, Scotland, reflecting the forest so they almost vanish.
works.description_zh: 六个等身镜面人形站在苏格兰阿伯福伊尔 David Marshall Lodge 的林中，映照着森林，几乎消失不见。
works.idea_en: Figures made only of reflections are the physical form of an 'invisible' AR character that is noticed only when it moves or catches light.
works.idea_zh: 只由倒影构成的人形是“隐形” AR 角色的实体形式，只有在移动或闪光时才会被注意到。
works.technique: Flat human silhouettes are cut from mirror-polished stainless steel and placed at varied angles so they reflect the surrounding trees.
works.technique_zh: 从镜面抛光不锈钢上切割出扁平的人形剪影，并以不同角度放置，映照周围树木。
works.exercise_en: Place AR human silhouettes with a real-time reflection material in a wooded area and let users try to find them. Twist: figures slowly change position when nobody is looking.
works.exercise_zh: 在林地中放置使用实时反射材质的 AR 人形剪影，让用户尝试找到它们；变体：没人看时，人形会慢慢改变位置。

works.title: Still
works.description: A mirrored man stands in the water of Loch Earn near St Fillians, reflecting the loch, the sky and the hills; the local community reinstalled it in 2023.
works.description_zh: 一个镜面人站在圣菲伦斯附近 Loch Earn 湖的水中，映出湖面、天空与山丘；当地社区在 2023 年重新安装了它。
works.idea_en: A figure standing in water that only shows water is a clean example of camouflage through reflection, useful for subtle AR presence.
works.idea_zh: 一个站在水中、只显示水的人形，是借助反射实现伪装的简洁例子，对含蓄的 AR 存在感很有用。
works.technique: A stainless-steel figure polished to a mirror finish is fixed on a base under the water surface.
works.technique_zh: 一个抛光至镜面的不锈钢人形固定在水面下的底座上。
works.exercise_en: Place a mirrored AR figure standing in a real pond or fountain with a screen-space reflection shader and film it at dawn and dusk. Twist: its reflection shows a different time of day than the real scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用屏幕空间反射着色器，在真实的池塘或喷泉中放置一个站立的镜面 AR 人形，并在黎明和黄昏拍摄；变体：它的倒影显示与真实场景不同的时刻。

works.title: Skytower
works.description: A six-metre public sculpture in Airdrie, Scotland, made of 2,000 metres of steel rod shaped like willow and woven together, as if the wind had scattered and reshaped the structure.
works.description_zh: 苏格兰艾尔德里的一件六米高公共雕塑，由 2000 米长、弯成柳枝状的钢条编织而成，仿佛风吹散又重塑了这个结构。
works.idea_en: Steel drawn like wind-blown willow shows how a form can record a force, a starting point for AR sculptures shaped by real wind data.
works.idea_zh: 像被风吹动的柳条一样勾画的钢材说明，形体可以记录一种力量，这是用真实风数据塑造 AR 雕塑的起点。
works.technique: Over 2,000 metres of 12 mm steel rod were bent, interwoven and secured with more than 6,000 welds.
works.technique_zh: 超过 2000 米长的 12 毫米钢条被弯曲、编织，并用 6000 多个焊点固定。
works.exercise_en: Generate an AR tower of curved lines whose lean and spread follow the live wind direction and speed at your location. Twist: record a whole day and freeze the tower as a sculpture of that day's wind.
works.exercise_zh: 生成一座由曲线组成的 AR 塔，其倾斜与散开程度跟随当地实时风向和风速；变体：记录一整天，把塔凝固成当天之风的雕塑。

works.title: Beyond Walls
works.description: Started under the Eiffel Tower in 2019, Beyond Walls is a chain of giant painted hands clasping each other on grass across cities worldwide (Paris, Geneva, Berlin, Istanbul, Cape Town and more), each visible from the air.
works.description_zh: 2019 年从埃菲尔铁塔下开始，《Beyond Walls》是一条由巨大的相握双手组成、延伸至世界各地城市草地上的链条（巴黎、日内瓦、柏林、伊斯坦布尔、开普敦等），每一幅都能从空中看见。
works.idea_en: One motif repeated city by city builds a world-spanning chain, a model for a location AR campaign where each site adds a link.
works.idea_zh: 同一个图案一城接一城地重复，组成一条跨越世界的链条，是每个地点添加一环的位置 AR 活动的范本。
works.technique: Hands are sprayed on grass with a homemade biodegradable paint (chalk, charcoal, milk proteins), working from a grid drawn on the ground.
works.technique_zh: 双手图案用自制可降解颜料（粉笔、木炭、牛奶蛋白）喷在草地上，依据地面上画出的网格施工。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR 'hand' that any user can place at their location, anchored so that it links to the nearest other hand on a shared world map. Twist: the chain only glows when it forms an unbroken line across a whole city.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一只任何用户都能在自己所在地放置的 AR“手”，锚定后与共享世界地图上最近的另一只手相连；变体：只有当链条在一座城市中连成不间断的线时才会发光。

works.title: Land Art au col des Aravis
works.description: On a meadow at the Col des Aravis in the French Alps, Saype paints a giant figure on the steep grass, readable from the road and the opposite slope.
works.description_zh: 在法国阿尔卑斯山的阿拉维斯山口草甸上，Saype 在陡峭的草坡上画出一个巨大的人物，从公路和对面山坡都能看清。
works.idea_en: A picture painted on a slope is designed for the view from across the valley, an early lesson in anamorphic placement for AR.
works.idea_zh: 画在斜坡上的图像是为山谷对面的视角设计的，这是 AR 变形放置的早期一课。
works.technique: The artist sprays biodegradable paint freehand guided by points marked on the slope, correcting for the perspective of the viewing point.
works.technique_zh: 艺术家依据斜坡上标记的点徒手喷涂可降解颜料，并针对观看点的透视进行校正。
works.exercise_en: Project a drawing in AR onto a sloping lawn so that it looks correct only from one chosen viewing point across the field. Twist: show visitors the distorted version first and let them find the right spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一幅图投到倾斜的草坪上，使其只从场地对面某个选定观看点看起来正确；变体：先让访客看到变形版本，再让他们自己找到正确位置。

works.title: Leysin land art (world record)
works.description: In Leysin, Switzerland, Saype painted an ephemeral 10,000-square-metre figure on a hillside, then a world record for the largest painting on grass.
works.description_zh: 在瑞士莱森，Saype 在山坡上画出一幅面积达一万平方米的短暂人像，创下当时草地绘画面积的世界纪录。
works.idea_en: At this size the image becomes landscape, and it disappears as the grass grows: scale and decay are both part of the work.
works.idea_zh: 在这种尺度下，图像本身就成了风景，并随着草的生长而消失：尺度与消逝都是作品的一部分。
works.technique: Chalk-and-charcoal paint is sprayed across the hillside following a grid scaled up from a drawing.
works.technique_zh: 粉笔与木炭颜料按照从草图放大而来的网格，被喷在整个山坡上。
works.exercise_en: Place a 100-metre AR drawing on a sports field and check where it can be read from (ground, stairs, rooftop). Twist: the drawing fades a little each day, like grass growing over it.
works.exercise_zh: 在运动场上放一幅 100 米长的 AR 绘画，检查从哪些地方（地面、楼梯、屋顶）能读懂它；变体：画面每天淡去一点，像被生长的草覆盖。

works.title: Message from Future
works.description: In Geneva, a 5,000-square-metre painting of a girl folding a paper boat made of a map of the world supports the rescue ship Aquarius and migrants crossing the sea.
works.description_zh: 在日内瓦，一幅 5000 平方米的画作描绘一个女孩用世界地图折纸船，以声援救援船 Aquarius 与横渡大海的移民。
works.idea_en: A message painted into a landscape can speak for a cause at the scale of a city, a strong use of large-scale location AR.
works.idea_zh: 画进风景里的信息能以城市尺度为某个议题发声，这是大尺度位置 AR 的有力用法。
works.technique: Painted with biodegradable pigments on a lakeside lawn, sized to be read by drones and from surrounding buildings.
works.technique_zh: 用可降解颜料画在湖边草坪上，尺寸按无人机和周围建筑的视角设计。
works.exercise_en: Paint a message for a cause as a giant AR image on a lawn and share it as a geo-anchored post that others can visit. Twist: the image reveals a second message when seen from directly above.
works.exercise_zh: 把为某个议题发声的信息画成草坪上的巨大 AR 图像，并以地理锚定帖子的形式分享给他人前往观看；变体：从正上方看时，图像会显出第二条信息。

works.title: Beyond Walls, Champ de Mars
works.description: Under the Eiffel Tower, Saype painted a 600-metre chain of joined hands on the lawns of the Champ de Mars, the first step of Beyond Walls.
works.description_zh: 在埃菲尔铁塔下，Saype 在战神广场的草坪上画出一条 600 米长、手手相握的链条，这是《Beyond Walls》的第一步。
works.idea_en: Placing the image under a famous viewpoint (the Eiffel Tower) guarantees an audience from above, a tactic for AR content anchored near lookouts.
works.idea_zh: 把图像放在著名观景点（埃菲尔铁塔）下方，保证了来自上方的观众，这是在观景台附近锚定 AR 内容的策略。
works.technique: Paint was sprayed over several days across the lawn from a gridded plan, readable from the tower's viewing decks.
works.technique_zh: 按照网格方案，几天内在草坪上完成喷绘，从铁塔观景台上可以看清。
works.exercise_en: Find the highest publicly accessible point on campus and design an AR image on the ground below that only makes sense from there. Twist: add a matching small image at ground level that points people up to the lookout.
works.exercise_zh: 找到校园里公众可到达的最高点，设计一幅只有从那里俯看才有意义的地面 AR 图像；变体：在地面加一幅配套的小图，引导人们登上观景点。

works.title: World in Progress
works.description: For the 75th anniversary of the United Nations, Saype painted two children drawing a round of people holding hands on the lawn of the Palais des Nations park in Geneva.
works.description_zh: 为纪念联合国成立 75 周年，Saype 在日内瓦万国宫公园的草坪上画出两个孩子正在描绘一圈手拉手的人。
works.idea_en: A picture of children drawing the world on the ground is a meta image of what location AR does: people drawing on the planet.
works.idea_zh: 孩子在地面上画世界的图像，是对位置 AR 所做之事的元描绘：人们在地球上作画。
works.technique: Painted with his biodegradable mix on the park's lawn at monumental scale.
works.technique_zh: 用他自制的可降解颜料在公园草坪上以巨大尺度绘制。
works.exercise_en: Make a shared AR ground-drawing app where each user adds one figure to a circle of held hands on a lawn. Twist: the circle closes only when it reaches one figure per country represented in the class.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个共享 AR 地面绘画应用，让每个用户在草坪上为一圈手拉手的人添加一个人物；变体：只有当人数达到班级中每个国家各一人时，圆圈才会闭合。

works.title: Sand drawings
works.description: Walking with a stick on the beach at low tide, Denevan draws huge circles and geometric patterns that can only be seen fully from the cliffs or the air before the tide erases them.
works.description_zh: Denevan 在退潮的海滩上拿着木棍边走边画，画出只能从悬崖或空中完整看到的巨大圆形和几何图案，随后被潮水抹去。
works.idea_en: Drawing at the scale of walking and seeing at the scale of flying is exactly the gap AR can close with a live overhead view.
works.idea_zh: 以步行尺度作画、以飞行尺度观看，这正是 AR 可以用实时俯视视角弥合的差距。
works.technique: He lays out circles by walking at a fixed distance from a centre and repeats forms with measured paces, using only a stick.
works.technique_zh: 他以与圆心保持固定距离的方式行走来画圆，并用计量步伐重复形状，只用一根木棍。
works.exercise_en: Walk a pattern on a field while a WebXR app records the path and shows it as a line on a live mini-map. Twist: add rules (for example, circles must touch) and draw as a team.
works.exercise_zh: 在操场上走出一个图案，同时用 WebXR 应用记录路径并在实时小地图上显示成线条；变体：加上规则（例如圆必须相切），以团队形式作画。

works.title: Lake Baikal
works.description: With a small crew over two weeks, Denevan carved a pattern of circles spanning nine square miles into the snow on the frozen surface of Lake Baikal in Siberia, then the world's largest artwork.
works.description_zh: Denevan 带领小团队用两周时间，在西伯利亚贝加尔湖冰面的积雪上刻出一组覆盖九平方英里的圆形图案，是当时世界上最大的艺术作品。
works.idea_en: The drawing's scale is so large that only aircraft can see it, raising the question of who an AR work is for when its full view is private.
works.idea_zh: 这幅画的尺度大到只有飞机才能看到，提出了一个问题：当完整视图只属于少数人时，AR 作品是为谁而做？
works.technique: Circles were laid out with ropes and marked by dragging tools behind vehicles and on foot across the snow-covered ice.
works.technique_zh: 用绳索确定圆形，再通过车辆拖拽工具和徒步在覆雪的冰面上划出线条。
works.exercise_en: Plan a drawing larger than your campus on a map, then place segments of it in AR at real GPS points so each walker sees only a piece. Twist: combine all walkers' screenshots into one aerial view at the end.
works.exercise_zh: 在地图上规划一幅比校园还大的画，然后在真实 GPS 点上用 AR 放置其片段，每个行走者只能看到一部分；变体：最后把所有人的截图合成为一张俯视图。

works.title: Arcosanti
works.description: A short film shows Denevan drawing a vast geometric pattern into the desert ground near Arcosanti, the experimental town in Arizona, seen from a drone.
works.description_zh: 一部短片展示 Denevan 在亚利桑那州实验性小镇 Arcosanti 附近的沙漠地面上画出巨大的几何图案，由无人机拍摄。
works.idea_en: An ephemeral drawing beside a utopian architecture shows how a temporary layer can talk to a permanent site, as AR often does.
works.idea_zh: 在乌托邦建筑旁画下短暂的图案，说明临时图层可以与永久场所对话，AR 常常这样做。
works.technique: Lines are raked into the desert surface by walking with fixed stride lengths and cords from centre points.
works.technique_zh: 以固定步长行走，并用从中心点拉出的绳子，把线条耙进沙漠地表。
works.exercise_en: Draw an AR geometric pattern around a notable building on campus that relates to its floor plan. Twist: make the pattern visible only in the drone-view mode of the app.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园一座重要建筑周围画出与其平面图相关的 AR 几何图案；变体：只有在应用的无人机视角模式下才能看到图案。

works.title: St. Catharines
works.description: Over a week in St. Catharines, Ontario, Denevan drew a large land artwork of nested circles on open ground, filmed from the air by Peter Hinson.
works.description_zh: Denevan 在加拿大安大略省圣凯瑟琳斯用一周时间在空地上画出一件由嵌套圆组成的大型大地作品，由 Peter Hinson 航拍记录。
works.idea_en: Nested circles made one by one show how a big pattern can be built step by step by a single person, like incremental AR drawing.
works.idea_zh: 一个个画出的嵌套圆说明，一个人也能一步步建起巨大的图案，就像逐步增量的 AR 绘画。
works.technique: Circles are marked by walking around a fixed centre with a rope and cutting or raking the ground.
works.technique_zh: 用绳子绕固定圆心行走，并刻划或耙动地面来标出圆。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as a 'rope': anchor a centre point in AR and draw a circle on the ground as you walk while keeping the distance constant. Twist: every new circle must touch two earlier ones.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机当作“绳子”：在 AR 中锚定一个中心点，一边保持距离一边行走，在地面画出圆；变体：每个新圆都必须与之前的两个圆相切。

works.title: Earthscapes
works.description: At low tide on Californian beaches, Amador rakes huge fractal and organic patterns into the wet sand in a few hours; the rising tide erases them.
works.description_zh: 在加州海滩退潮时，Amador 用几个小时在湿沙上耙出巨大的分形与有机图案；涨潮后它们便被抹去。
works.idea_en: Working inside a fixed window of time (between tides) is a design constraint that AR events can borrow.
works.idea_zh: 在固定的时间窗口（两次潮汐之间）内工作，是 AR 活动可以借用的设计约束。
works.technique: He shades areas by raking the top layer of wet sand, creating contrast between smooth and textured surfaces, following a rough plan.
works.technique_zh: 他依据粗略的规划，耙动湿沙表层来“着色”，在平滑与粗糙的表面之间制造对比。
works.exercise_en: Create an AR drawing tool that works only during a set daily window (for example, the next low tide from a tide API), and erases everything when it closes. Twist: draw with texture instead of colour.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个只在每天固定时间窗口内（例如根据潮汐 API 得到的下一次低潮）可用的 AR 绘画工具，窗口关闭时一切都会被抹去；变体：用纹理而不是颜色作画。

works.title: Mandala I
works.description: A time-lapse shows Amador raking a large radially symmetric mandala into the sand, seen from above as the pattern grows ring by ring.
works.description_zh: 延时影像展示 Amador 在沙滩上耙出一个巨大的径向对称曼陀罗，从上方看，图案一圈圈地生长。
works.idea_en: Radial symmetry lets a human-scale gesture add up to a readable image from above, a principle for AR ground patterns.
works.idea_zh: 径向对称让人体尺度的动作累积成从上方可读的图像，这是 AR 地面图案的一条原则。
works.technique: He marks a centre, lays out rings with a rope and repeats the same motif around each ring.
works.technique_zh: 他先标出中心，用绳子定出圆环，再在每一圈重复同一个图案。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR mandala tool: anything the user draws on the ground is repeated eight times around a centre point. Twist: the symmetry count increases with each new ring.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 AR 曼陀罗工具：用户在地面上画的任何东西都会围绕中心点重复八次；变体：每新增一圈，对称数就增加。

works.title: Guided group beach mandala
works.description: Amador leads a group of participants who rake a large mandala together on the beach, each person responsible for part of the pattern.
works.description_zh: Amador 带领一群参与者在海滩上一起耙出一个巨大的曼陀罗，每人负责图案的一部分。
works.idea_en: Splitting a big image into simple local tasks lets strangers co-create, a model for multi-user AR drawing sessions.
works.idea_zh: 把一张大图拆成简单的局部任务，让陌生人也能共同创作，是多人 AR 绘画会话的范本。
works.technique: Each participant gets a sector and a simple instruction; the radial layout keeps everyone's parts aligned.
works.technique_zh: 每位参与者分到一个扇区和一条简单指令；径向布局让大家的部分保持对齐。
works.exercise_en: Run a shared AR drawing session where each student is assigned one sector of a ground mandala and can only draw inside it. Twist: sectors rotate every five minutes so everyone finishes someone else's work.
works.exercise_zh: 开展一次共享 AR 绘画会话，给每位学生分配地面曼陀罗的一个扇区，只能在其中作画；变体：每五分钟轮换扇区，让每个人都去完成别人的作品。

works.title: Evolution and Theory
works.description: Hundreds of small aluminium figures inspired by Victorian science illustrations (hybrids of humans, animals and machines) stand in a field of sand, installed piece by piece in a time-lapse.
works.description_zh: 数百个受维多利亚时代科学插图启发的铝制小人偶（人、动物与机器的混合体）立在一片沙地中，延时影像记录了它们被逐个安装的过程。
works.idea_en: A crowd of tiny strange figures on sand becomes a world to lean over and explore, like a tabletop AR diorama.
works.idea_zh: 沙地上一群奇异的小人成了一个可以俯身探索的世界，就像桌面 AR 微缩场景。
works.technique: Figures are cut from aluminium sheet, hand-painted and stood in a bed of sand in a loose grid.
works.technique_zh: 人偶由铝板切割、手工上色，以松散的网格插在沙床上。
works.exercise_en: Place 200 tiny AR figures made from public-domain engravings on a table or sandbox and let users walk around them with a phone. Twist: figures slowly swap body parts with their neighbours over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用公共领域的版画人物制作 200 个小型 AR 人偶，放在桌面或沙盘上，让用户拿着手机绕行观看；变体：随着时间推移，人偶会慢慢与邻居交换身体部件。

works.title: Blackfield
works.description: Thousands of tiny steel flowers are planted in white sand; from one side they are all black and burnt-looking, but when you walk around they turn into bright colours.
works.description_zh: 成千上万朵小钢花插在白沙中；从一侧看它们全是烧焦般的黑色，绕到另一侧，它们却变成鲜艳的色彩。
works.idea_en: The same field tells two opposite stories depending on where you stand, a direct model for viewpoint-dependent AR.
works.idea_zh: 同一片花田会因你站的位置不同而讲出两个相反的故事，是依赖视点的 AR 的直接范本。
works.technique: Each etched steel flower is painted black on one side and in colour on the other, and all are oriented the same way.
works.technique_zh: 每朵蚀刻钢花一面涂黑，另一面上色，并且全部朝向同一方向。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR field of flat flowers that are black when seen from the north and colourful when seen from the south, using a view-direction shader. Twist: the colours on the bright side come from photos visitors take.
works.exercise_zh: 用视线方向着色器制作一片 AR 扁平花田：从北面看是黑色，从南面看是彩色；变体：彩色一面的颜色取自访客拍摄的照片。

works.title: People I Saw But Never Met
works.description: Over 9,000 small steel silhouettes of people from 20 countries, drawn from photographs of strangers, stand together on the ground in Vila Nova de Cerveira, Portugal.
works.description_zh: 来自 20 个国家、以陌生人照片为原型的 9000 多个小钢制人影站在葡萄牙维拉诺瓦德塞尔维拉的地面上。
works.idea_en: A crowd of strangers at a small scale lets you walk among everyone at once, like an AR visualisation of a population.
works.idea_zh: 一群缩小的陌生人让你一次就能行走在所有人之间，就像人口的 AR 可视化。
works.technique: Silhouettes are traced from photos of passers-by, cut from steel and stood upright in a large grid on the floor.
works.technique_zh: 人影取自路人照片的轮廓，由钢板切割后以大网格直立在地面上。
works.exercise_en: Collect silhouettes of 100 people with body segmentation, turn them into small flat AR figures and stand them on a courtyard floor. Twist: each figure turns toward the visitor who resembles it most in height.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割收集 100 个人的剪影，把它们做成小型扁平 AR 人像，立在庭院地面上；变体：每个人像会转向身高与它最接近的访客。

works.title: Sculpture park and houses to watch the sunset
works.description: In a Louisiana Channel film, Not Vital shows his sculpture park in Sent, his foundation in Tarasp Castle and the buildings he makes around the world, including houses built only to watch the sunset.
works.description_zh: 在 Louisiana Channel 的影片中，Not Vital 展示了他在森特的雕塑公园、塔拉斯普城堡中的基金会，以及他在世界各地建造的建筑，包括只为看日落而建的房子。
works.idea_en: A building that exists only to frame one moment of the day is a pure example of designing an experience around time and place, as AR can.
works.idea_zh: 一座只为框住一天中某个时刻而存在的建筑，是围绕时间和地点设计体验的纯粹例子，AR 也可以这样做。
works.technique: Simple sculptural structures with stairs and openings are oriented to the sunset and built with local materials and labour.
works.technique_zh: 带有阶梯和开口的简单雕塑性结构朝向日落，用当地材料与人力建造。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR platform with a single framed opening on a hill so it aligns with today's sunset azimuth, and invite people to climb it at sunset. Twist: the opening closes after the sun has gone down.
works.exercise_zh: 在山坡上放一个只有一个框形开口的 AR 平台，使其对准今天日落的方位角，并邀请人们在日落时登上去；变体：太阳落下后开口会关闭。

works.title: Untilled
works.description: In a compost heap of Kassel's Karlsaue park for documenta 13, a reclining nude sculpture with a living beehive for a head, a white dog with a pink leg and toxic plants coexisted and changed without the artist.
works.description_zh: 在第 13 届卡塞尔文献展的卡尔绍公园堆肥场中，一尊头部是活蜂巢的斜卧裸女雕塑、一只一条腿被染成粉色的白狗和一些有毒植物共同生活，在没有艺术家干预的情况下不断变化。
works.idea_en: The work is a system of living parts left to run by itself, a model for AR ecosystems that evolve whether or not anyone is watching.
works.idea_zh: 作品是一个任其自行运转的活系统，是无论有无观众都在演化的 AR 生态系统的范本。
works.technique: Huyghe set conditions (plants, animals, a sculpture colonised by bees) and let biological processes shape the site over 100 days.
works.technique_zh: Huyghe 设定条件（植物、动物、被蜜蜂占据的雕塑），然后让生物过程在 100 天里塑造这片场地。
works.exercise_en: Build a small AR ecosystem on a table with simple agents (plants, insects, a creature) that keep evolving in a persistent cloud anchor between visits. Twist: users can only observe, never touch.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上用简单智能体（植物、昆虫、一只生物）搭建一个小型 AR 生态系统，它在持久化云锚点中持续演化，每次到访都不同；变体：用户只能观察，永远不能触碰。

works.title: After ALife Ahead
works.description: For Skulptur Projekte Münster, Huyghe cut open the concrete floor of a former ice rink, revealing layers of earth, water, algae, bees and a peacock; cancer cells growing in an incubator controlled the ceiling panels and an AR layer of pyramids.
works.description_zh: 为明斯特雕塑展，Huyghe 切开一座旧溜冰场的混凝土地面，露出土层、水、藻类、蜜蜂和一只孔雀；培养箱中生长的癌细胞控制着天花板面板和一层 AR 金字塔。
works.idea_en: A living process drives both physical architecture and digital overlays, showing how AR can be steered by a real-world signal rather than the user.
works.idea_zh: 一个活的过程同时驱动实体建筑和数字叠加，说明 AR 可以由现实世界的信号而非用户来驱动。
works.technique: Sensors track the growth of HeLa cells in an incubator and use the data to open ceiling panels and spawn augmented reality forms in an app.
works.technique_zh: 传感器追踪培养箱中 HeLa 细胞的生长，并用这些数据打开天花板面板、在应用中生成增强现实形体。
works.exercise_en: Connect a real-world signal (a plant's soil moisture sensor or a webcam of a fish tank) to the spawn rate of AR shapes in a room. Twist: when the signal stops changing, the AR layer slowly dies.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个现实世界信号（植物土壤湿度传感器或鱼缸摄像头）连接到房间中 AR 形体的生成速率；变体：当信号停止变化时，AR 图层慢慢死去。

works.title: Safe Passage (Konzerthaus Berlin)
works.description: The columns of Berlin's Konzerthaus were wrapped with 14,000 life jackets collected from refugees who had landed on the Greek island of Lesbos, with a rubber boat hanging in front.
works.description_zh: 柏林音乐厅的立柱被包裹上 14000 件救生衣，这些救生衣收集自在希腊莱斯沃斯岛登岸的难民，门前还悬挂着一艘橡皮艇。
works.idea_en: Covering a cultural landmark with the objects of a crisis brings a distant fact onto a local building, a strategy for AR data overlays on monuments.
works.idea_zh: 用一场危机的物件覆盖一座文化地标，把遥远的事实带到本地建筑上，这是在纪念建筑上做 AR 数据叠加的策略。
works.technique: Real orange life jackets were attached in dense rows to the building's columns, forming a bright facade layer.
works.technique_zh: 真实的橙色救生衣被密集成排地固定在建筑的立柱上，形成一层醒目的立面。
works.exercise_en: Wrap the columns or facade of a real building in AR with a repeated object that stands for a dataset (one object per person affected). Twist: the count updates from a live public dataset.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用一个重复的物件包裹真实建筑的立柱或立面，每个物件代表一个受影响的人；变体：数量随实时公开数据更新。

works.title: Forever Bicycles
works.description: For Nuit Blanche Toronto, 3,144 identical bicycles were linked into a huge tunnel-like structure over Nathan Phillips Square that shifts into different patterns as you walk around it.
works.description_zh: 为多伦多 Nuit Blanche 艺术节，3144 辆相同的自行车在内森·菲利普斯广场上连接成一个巨大的隧道般结构，绕行时会呈现不同的图案。
works.idea_en: Thousands of identical parts create moiré-like patterns that change with the viewer's position, a direct recipe for instanced AR structures.
works.idea_zh: 成千上万个相同部件产生随观者位置变化的莫尔纹般图案，是实例化 AR 结构的直接配方。
works.technique: Frames of 'Forever' brand bicycles, with wheels and handles removed, are bolted together in a modular grid.
works.technique_zh: 去掉车轮和把手的“永久”牌自行车车架被螺栓连接成模块化网格。
works.exercise_en: Instance 2,000 copies of one scanned object in a grid arch in AR over a walkway and walk through it to see how patterns shift. Twist: each copy rotates a few degrees according to the user's walking speed.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个扫描物件实例化 2000 份，排成跨越人行道的网格拱，走过去观察图案如何变化；变体：每个副本按用户步速旋转几度。

works.title: Good Fences Make Good Neighbors
works.description: Across New York City, Ai placed more than 300 fences, cages and banners, including a golden cage at Central Park's entrance and a mirrored passage under the Washington Square Arch, about migration and borders.
works.description_zh: 在纽约全城，艾未未放置了 300 多件围栏、笼子和横幅，包括中央公园入口处的金色笼子和华盛顿广场拱门下的镜面通道，主题关于移民与边界。
works.idea_en: Spreading one theme over hundreds of city sites makes a whole city the exhibition, a model for citywide AR shows.
works.idea_zh: 把一个主题分散到城市中数百处地点，让整座城市成为展览，是全城 AR 展览的范本。
works.technique: Site-specific fence structures were fabricated in steel and installed in parks, bus shelters and lamp posts in all five boroughs.
works.technique_zh: 为特定场地定制的钢制围栏结构被安装在五个行政区的公园、公交站和路灯杆上。
works.exercise_en: Create a citywide AR show: anchor 20 small cage or fence pieces at bus stops and gates around campus, each with a short story about a boundary. Twist: some pieces can only be seen from inside a fence.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一场全城 AR 展：在校园周边的公交站和大门处锚定 20 件小型笼子或围栏作品，每件附带一个关于边界的小故事；变体：有些作品只有站在围栏内才能看到。

works.title: Circle of Animals/Zodiac Heads
works.description: Twelve large bronze animal heads of the Chinese zodiac, based on the looted fountain-clock heads of the Old Summer Palace in Beijing, stand in a circle in public plazas such as the Pulitzer Fountain in New York.
works.description_zh: 十二个大型十二生肖青铜兽首以北京圆明园被掠夺的水力钟兽首为原型，在纽约普利策喷泉等公共广场上围成一圈。
works.idea_en: Re-staging lost heritage objects at monumental size in a public square asks who owns them, a question AR restitution projects also face.
works.idea_zh: 在公共广场上以巨大尺度重现遗失的文物，引出“它们属于谁”的问题，AR 文物回归项目也面临同样的问题。
works.technique: Each head was modelled from the surviving and missing originals, enlarged and cast in bronze on columns.
works.technique_zh: 每个兽首依据现存与遗失的原件建模，放大后铸成青铜，立在柱子上。
works.exercise_en: Scan or find 3D models of museum objects removed from their original site and place them back in AR at their place of origin. Twist: show the route each object travelled as an AR line on a map.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描或找到被带离原址的博物馆藏品的 3D 模型，用 AR 把它们放回原来的地方；变体：用地图上的 AR 线条显示每件物品流转的路线。

works.title: Law of the Journey
works.description: A 60-metre black inflatable boat crowded with 258 faceless rubber refugee figures fills a hall, shown at the National Gallery in Prague and the 21st Biennale of Sydney.
works.description_zh: 一艘长 60 米、挤满 258 个无脸橡胶难民人偶的黑色充气船填满整个展厅，曾在布拉格国家美术馆和第 21 届悉尼双年展展出。
works.idea_en: Scaling up a news image until you must walk along it turns a picture into a body experience, what AR can do with a photograph.
works.idea_zh: 把新闻图像放大到你必须沿着它行走的程度，就把一张图片变成了身体经验，这正是 AR 可以对照片做的事。
works.technique: The boat and figures were made from the same black rubber used for refugee dinghies, fabricated in China.
works.technique_zh: 船与人偶使用与难民橡皮艇相同的黑色橡胶，在中国制作。
works.exercise_en: Take a news photo of a crowd and rebuild it as a 1:1 AR scene of simple figures that users can walk along. Twist: every figure has a short, real testimony that plays when approached.
works.exercise_zh: 选取一张人群的新闻照片，把它重建为 1:1 的 AR 场景，用简单人形表示，用户可以沿着它行走；变体：每个人形都附带一段真实证词，靠近时播放。

works.title: Sunflower Seeds
works.description: The floor of Tate Modern's Turbine Hall was covered with 100 million hand-painted porcelain sunflower seeds, made by about 1,600 craftspeople in Jingdezhen.
works.description_zh: 泰特现代美术馆涡轮大厅的地面铺满了一亿颗手绘瓷制葵花籽，由景德镇约 1600 名工匠制作。
works.idea_en: A landscape made of countless individual, handmade units shows the one and the many at once, a strong idea for AR crowds and data points.
works.idea_zh: 由无数独立手工单元组成的地景同时呈现了个体与群体，是 AR 群体与数据点的有力创意。
works.technique: Each seed was shaped, fired and hand-painted with a few brushstrokes, then spread in a layer about 10 cm deep.
works.technique_zh: 每颗瓜子都经过成型、烧制，并用几笔手工绘制，然后铺成约 10 厘米厚的一层。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room floor in AR with 100,000 instanced seeds and let each user 'paint' one unique seed that is added to the pile. Twist: the user can later find their own seed with a search function.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用十万颗实例化的瓜子铺满房间地面，让每位用户“画”一颗独特的瓜子加入其中；变体：用户之后可以用搜索功能找到自己的那一颗。

works.title: Strandbeest evolution (archive)
works.description: A compilation of Strandbeests from 1990 onward walking along Dutch beaches, powered only by wind, from early fragile models to large beasts that store air in plastic bottles.
works.description_zh: 一部汇编影片，展示自 1990 年以来的海滩生物在荷兰海滩上仅凭风力行走，从早期脆弱的模型到能把空气储存在塑料瓶里的大型生物。
works.idea_en: A machine that walks by the wind makes an invisible force legible as a creature, a good model for AR creatures driven by real sensor data.
works.idea_zh: 一台靠风行走的机器，把无形的力量表现为一只生物，是由真实传感器数据驱动的 AR 生物的好范本。
works.technique: Each leg is a Jansen linkage of PVC tubes whose proportions (found by a genetic algorithm) turn rotation into a smooth walking step.
works.technique_zh: 每条腿都是由 PVC 管组成的 Jansen 连杆，其比例由遗传算法求得，把旋转转化为平稳的步行。
works.exercise_en: Simulate a Jansen linkage in Unity or p5.js, place the walking beast on a beach or lawn in AR and drive its speed with live wind data. Twist: it stops and 'anchors' itself when the wind gets too strong.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 p5.js 中模拟 Jansen 连杆，把行走的生物放在 AR 中的海滩或草坪上，并用实时风数据驱动它的速度；变体：风太大时它会停下来“锚定”自己。

works.title: Strandbeest Evolution 2021
works.description: Jansen's annual report: every spring he takes a new beast to the beach, tests it against wind, sand and water all summer, and in autumn declares it extinct and moves it to the 'bone yard'.
works.description_zh: Jansen 的年度报告：每年春天他带一只新生物去海滩，整个夏天在风、沙和水中测试它，秋天宣布它“灭绝”，把它送进“骨场”。
works.idea_en: Treating each version as a species with a life cycle turns iteration into narrative, a way to present AR prototypes as a lineage.
works.idea_zh: 把每个版本当作有生命周期的物种，把迭代变成了叙事，这是把 AR 原型呈现为一条谱系的方法。
works.technique: New leg mechanisms, sails and air-storage systems are built each year and tested on the beach with live wind.
works.technique_zh: 每年制作新的腿部机构、风帆和储气系统，并在海滩上用真实的风测试。
works.exercise_en: Show all versions of your semester's AR prototype side by side as a 'museum of extinct species' in one AR scene. Twist: each prototype has a label with its birth date, cause of extinction and descendant.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个 AR 场景中把本学期 AR 原型的所有版本并排展示为“灭绝物种博物馆”；变体：每个原型都有标签，写明诞生日期、灭绝原因和后代。

works.title: Strandbeest Evolution 2025
works.description: The 2025 update on the Strandbeest family, which has been evolving since 1990, shows the newest beast walking on the beach and its experiments with wind and water.
works.description_zh: 2025 年海滩生物家族的最新进展：这个家族自 1990 年起不断演化，影片展示最新一代在海滩上行走，以及它对风和水的实验。
works.idea_en: Thirty-five years of one idea show that depth comes from iterating on a single system, a lesson for long-running AR projects.
works.idea_zh: 一个想法持续三十五年，说明深度来自对同一系统的反复迭代，这是长期 AR 项目的一课。
works.technique: Continuation of the PVC linkage system with new adaptations tested on the beach.
works.technique_zh: 延续 PVC 连杆系统，并在海滩上测试新的适应性改进。
works.exercise_en: Give an AR creature three 'genes' (leg length, speed, sail size) and let the class breed a new generation each week by combining the fittest. Twist: fitness is measured by how far it walks in the real wind outside.
works.exercise_zh: 给一只 AR 生物三个“基因”（腿长、速度、帆的大小），让全班每周把表现最好的个体组合起来繁育新一代；变体：适应度以它在户外真实风中走了多远来衡量。

works.title: Seven Magic Mountains
works.description: Seven towers of stacked limestone boulders, painted in fluorescent colours and up to 11 metres tall, stand in the Nevada desert south of Las Vegas.
works.description_zh: 七座由石灰岩巨石堆叠而成、涂着荧光色、高达 11 米的石塔立在拉斯维加斯以南的内华达沙漠中。
works.idea_en: Bright artificial colour against a natural landscape reads instantly as 'placed', the look many AR objects have, used here on purpose.
works.idea_zh: 在自然风景中使用鲜艳的人工色彩，会立即被读作“被放置的”，这正是许多 AR 物体的样子，在这里被有意使用。
works.technique: Locally quarried boulders were stacked on steel pins and painted with bright, weather-resistant paint.
works.technique_zh: 就地开采的巨石用钢销叠放固定，并涂上鲜艳的耐候涂料。
works.exercise_en: Stack scanned rocks into seven AR totems in a desert-like space and paint each stone a flat bright colour. Twist: let visitors restack one stone per visit.
works.exercise_zh: 把扫描的石头在类似荒漠的空地上叠成七座 AR 图腾，并给每块石头涂上纯色；变体：让每位访客每次到访可以重新叠放一块石头。

works.title: Human Nature
works.description: Nine stone giants, 5 to 6 metres tall and made of stacked bluestone blocks, stood in Rockefeller Plaza in New York among the office towers.
works.description_zh: 九个由青石块堆叠而成、高五到六米的石头巨人立在纽约洛克菲勒广场的写字楼之间。
works.idea_en: Crude, ancient-looking figures in a polished business plaza create strong contrast, a design cue for AR figures that do not blend in.
works.idea_zh: 在光鲜的商业广场上放置粗犷、仿佛古老的人像，形成强烈对比，这是不试图融入环境的 AR 形象的设计提示。
works.technique: Rough-hewn bluestone slabs were stacked to form head, body and legs and fixed with internal steel.
works.technique_zh: 粗凿的青石板堆叠成头、身体和腿，并用内部钢件固定。
works.exercise_en: Build rough stacked-stone AR giants from three to five blocks each and place them among glass buildings on campus. Twist: the giants slowly rotate to face whoever is closest.
works.exercise_zh: 用三到五块石头搭成粗糙的叠石 AR 巨人，放在校园的玻璃建筑之间；变体：巨人会慢慢转身面向离它最近的人。

works.title: Liverpool Mountain
works.description: A stack of brightly painted boulders stands on the Liverpool waterfront outside Tate Liverpool, bringing the desert totem idea into a port city.
works.description_zh: 一座由鲜艳彩绘巨石堆成的石柱立在利物浦泰特美术馆外的滨水区，把沙漠图腾的概念带进了港口城市。
works.idea_en: The same object placed in a new setting (desert to harbour) changes its meaning, which AR creators can test instantly by relocating content.
works.idea_zh: 同一件物体换了环境（从沙漠到港口）就改变了意义，AR 创作者可以通过移动内容立即检验这一点。
works.technique: Boulders were stacked on a steel core and painted in solid bright colours.
works.technique_zh: 巨石叠在钢芯上，并涂上纯色的鲜艳颜料。
works.exercise_en: Place the same bright AR totem in three places (a car park, a garden, a lobby) and interview passers-by about what it means in each. Twist: change one colour of the totem to match each site's dominant colour.
works.exercise_zh: 把同一个鲜艳的 AR 图腾放在三个地方（停车场、花园、大堂），询问路人在每处觉得它代表什么；变体：把图腾中的一种颜色换成每个场地的主色。

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Seoul
works.description: The first KAWS:HOLIDAY: a 28-metre inflatable COMPANION floats on its back on Seokchon Lake in Seoul, next to the Lotte World Tower, as if sunbathing during a heatwave.
works.description_zh: 第一站 KAWS:HOLIDAY：一个 28 米长的充气 COMPANION 仰面漂浮在首尔石村湖上，紧邻乐天世界塔，仿佛在热浪中晒太阳。
works.idea_en: A giant character doing something ordinary (sunbathing) in a real place is instantly shareable, the same reason giant AR characters spread online.
works.idea_zh: 一个巨大角色在真实地点做一件普通的事（晒太阳），立刻就适合分享，这也是巨型 AR 角色能在网上传播的原因。
works.technique: A large inflatable figure is tethered on the lake with anchors and ballast, produced with AllRightsReserved.
works.technique_zh: 大型充气人偶以锚和压载物系留在湖面上，由 AllRightsReserved 制作。
works.exercise_en: Place a 20-metre AR character lying on a real lake, pool or lawn, doing an everyday activity, and design the best photo spot for it. Twist: it changes its pose according to the local weather.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的湖、泳池或草坪上放一个 20 米长、正在做日常活动的 AR 角色，并为它设计最佳拍照点；变体：它的姿势随当地天气变化。

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Taipei
works.description: A 36-metre seated COMPANION holding a smaller figure lies in Liberty Square in Taipei, in front of the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall; the opening was organised with singer JJ Lin.
works.description_zh: 一个 36 米长、怀抱小人偶的坐姿 COMPANION 躺在台北自由广场、中正纪念堂前；开幕式与歌手林俊杰合作举办。
works.idea_en: A soft, casual giant in front of a formal monument changes how the square feels, a contrast AR creators can use deliberately.
works.idea_zh: 一个柔软随意的巨人放在庄重的纪念建筑前，改变了广场给人的感觉，AR 创作者可以有意使用这种对比。
works.technique: A giant inflatable is anchored on the square with ballast, lit at night.
works.technique_zh: 巨型充气人偶用压载物固定在广场上，夜间有灯光照明。
works.exercise_en: Place a relaxed giant AR character in front of the most formal building on campus and film reactions. Twist: the character sits up whenever someone takes a photo.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园最庄重的建筑前放一个姿态放松的巨型 AR 角色，拍下人们的反应；变体：每当有人拍照，角色就会坐起来。

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Hong Kong
works.description: A 37-metre COMPANION floats on its back in Victoria Harbour in Hong Kong, moving between Tamar Park and Tsim Sha Tsui against the skyline.
works.description_zh: 一个 37 米长的 COMPANION 仰面漂浮在香港维多利亚港，在添马公园与尖沙咀之间移动，以天际线为背景。
works.idea_en: A floating giant that moves between harbour locations shows how an AR character can appear in different places on different days.
works.idea_zh: 一个在港口不同位置之间移动的漂浮巨人说明，AR 角色可以在不同日子出现在不同地点。
works.technique: The inflatable was mounted on a floating platform and towed between sites with the approval of harbour authorities.
works.technique_zh: 充气人偶安装在浮台上，经港务部门批准后在不同地点之间拖行。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR giant that appears at a different geolocated spot on campus each day, with a daily clue to find it. Twist: its route follows a real ferry or bus timetable.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个每天出现在校园不同地理位置的 AR 巨人，并每天发布寻找它的线索；变体：它的路线跟随真实的渡轮或公交时刻表。

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Japan
works.description: A 40-metre COMPANION lies on the grass of Fumotoppara campground with Mount Fuji behind it; visitors camp around the figure for a week.
works.description_zh: 一个 40 米长的 COMPANION 躺在富士山脚下麓原露营地的草地上，访客在它周围露营一周。
works.idea_en: Pairing a giant character with an iconic natural landmark gives every photo two anchors, a composition trick for AR.
works.idea_zh: 把巨型角色与标志性的自然地标搭配，让每张照片都有两个锚点，这是 AR 的构图技巧。
works.technique: An inflatable figure is anchored on the meadow, with camping infrastructure laid out around it.
works.technique_zh: 充气人偶固定在草地上，周围布置露营设施。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR character so it lines up with a real landmark (mountain, tower) from a marked photo spot. Twist: the character turns its head to look at the landmark at sunset.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一个 AR 角色，使其从标记好的拍照点看过去与真实地标（山、塔）对齐；变体：日落时角色会转头看向地标。

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Space
works.description: To mark COMPANION's 20th anniversary, a small figure in an astronaut suit was carried by a sounding balloon to 41.5 kilometres into the stratosphere and filmed floating above the Earth.
works.description_zh: 为纪念 COMPANION 诞生 20 周年，一个穿着宇航服的小人偶被探空气球带到 41.5 公里高的平流层，并被拍下漂浮在地球上空的画面。
works.idea_en: A small figure filmed against the curve of the Earth plays with scale in the opposite direction from the giants, a reminder that AR can shrink as well as enlarge.
works.idea_zh: 一个小人偶以地球弧线为背景被拍摄，与巨人们的尺度玩法正好相反，提醒我们 AR 既可以放大也可以缩小。
works.technique: A figure and cameras on a weather-balloon payload rose for about eight hours before descending by parachute.
works.technique_zh: 人偶和相机随气象气球载荷升空约八小时，然后用降落伞返回。
works.exercise_en: Launch an AR figure from your hand that rises until it becomes a speck against the real sky, and track it with a compass arrow. Twist: other users in the city can see where it drifted.
