works.exercise_zh: 从手中放飞一个 AR 人偶，让它一直上升到在真实天空中只剩一个小点，并用指南针箭头追踪它；变体：城市中的其他用户可以看到它飘到了哪里。

works.title: KAWS:HOLIDAY Changbai Mountain
works.description: For the eighth HOLIDAY, two COMPANION figures sitting together were built as a monumental snow sculpture at Changbai Mountain in Jilin, China.
works.description_zh: 第八站 HOLIDAY 在中国吉林长白山把两个并肩而坐的 COMPANION 做成了巨型雪雕。
works.idea_en: Making the character from the landscape's own material (snow) ties it to the season, an idea for AR objects whose material changes with weather.
works.idea_zh: 用风景本身的材料（雪）塑造角色，把它与季节绑定，这为材质随天气变化的 AR 物体提供了思路。
works.technique: The figures were carved from compacted snow on site at monumental scale.
works.technique_zh: 人偶在现场用压实的雪以巨大尺度雕刻而成。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR figure whose material switches between snow, grass and sand according to the current season or live weather at the location. Twist: it melts slowly when the temperature is above zero.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 AR 人像，其材质根据当前季节或当地实时天气在雪、草和沙之间切换；变体：当气温高于零度时它会慢慢融化。

works.title: Rubber Duck
works.description: A giant yellow rubber duck, up to 26 metres tall, has floated in more than twenty harbours since 2007, from Saint-Nazaire and Osaka to Hong Kong and Sydney, drawing crowds to the waterfront.
works.description_zh: 一只高达 26 米的巨型黄色橡皮鸭自 2007 年起在二十多个港口漂浮过，从圣纳泽尔、大阪到香港和悉尼，把人群吸引到水边。
works.idea_en: Scaling up a bath toy makes the city look like a bathtub, a perfect example of how size change alone creates a new story in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把一个浴缸玩具放大，让整座城市看起来像个浴缸，完美说明了只靠尺度变化就能在 AR 中创造新故事。
works.technique: A PVC inflatable is mounted on a floating pontoon and inflated with blowers, then towed around the harbour.
works.technique_zh: PVC 充气体安装在浮筒上，用鼓风机充气，然后在港内拖行。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small everyday object and place it at 20 metres tall in a real body of water or a plaza in AR. Twist: the object bobs to the rhythm of live wave or wind data.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一件日常小物，在 AR 中把它以 20 米的高度放在真实的水面或广场上；变体：物体随实时波浪或风数据的节奏起伏。

works.title: HippopoThames
works.description: For the Totally Thames festival in London, a 21-metre wooden hippo floated in the Thames at Nine Elms, rising from the water as if wading through the river.
works.description_zh: 为伦敦 Totally Thames 艺术节，一只长 21 米的木制河马漂浮在九榆树附近的泰晤士河中，仿佛正从水里涉水而过。
works.idea_en: An animal half-submerged reads as alive and moving through the real river, a good use of the water line as an AR occlusion boundary.
works.idea_zh: 一只半身没在水中的动物看起来像活着、正在河中穿行，这是把水线当作 AR 遮挡边界的好用法。
works.technique: A timber-clad frame shaped like the upper half of a hippo was built on a floating barge.
works.technique_zh: 在浮动驳船上搭建一个以木板包覆、形似河马上半身的框架。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR animal in a real river or pond so that only the top half shows above the waterline, using a water-plane occluder. Twist: it slowly swims upstream against the current.
works.exercise_zh: 用水面遮挡体，在真实的河或池塘中放一只 AR 动物，只露出水线以上的上半身；变体：它会逆流缓缓向上游游去。

works.title: Moon Rabbit
works.description: At the Taoyuan Land Art Festival in Taiwan, a 25-metre rabbit lies on its side gazing at the sky, a nod to the Mid-Autumn legend of the rabbit on the moon.
works.description_zh: 在台湾桃园地景艺术节上，一只 25 米长的兔子侧躺着凝望天空，呼应中秋节月兔的传说。
works.idea_en: Linking a giant figure to a local legend and festival gives it meaning beyond scale, a lesson for culturally specific AR.
works.idea_zh: 把巨型形象与当地传说和节日联系起来，赋予它尺度之外的意义，是在地文化 AR 的一课。
works.technique: A large fabric-covered form lies on the ground in the festival grounds, lit at night.
works.technique_zh: 一个覆有织物的大型形体卧在节日场地的地面上，夜间有灯光照明。
works.exercise_en: Choose a local legend and place its main character as a giant AR figure where the story is set. Twist: the figure appears only on the festival date or at the right moon phase.
works.exercise_zh: 选择一个本地传说，把主角作为巨型 AR 形象放在故事发生的地方；变体：形象只在节日当天或对应的月相出现。

works.title: Lookout Rabbit
works.description: A 12-metre rabbit with a red dot on its side stands in Valkhof Park in Nijmegen; visitors can climb inside and look out over the river Waal.
works.description_zh: 一只 12 米高、身侧有一个红点的兔子立在奈梅亨的法尔克霍夫公园；游客可以爬进去俯瞰瓦尔河。
works.idea_en: A giant figure you can enter and look out of turns a sculpture into a viewpoint, an idea for AR creatures that become portals.
works.idea_zh: 一个可以进入并向外眺望的巨型形象，把雕塑变成了观景点，这为可变成传送门的 AR 生物提供了思路。
works.technique: A timber frame shaped like a rabbit contains stairs and a viewing opening at the red dot.
works.technique_zh: 兔子形状的木框架内设有楼梯，红点处是观景开口。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR animal with a door; when the user steps inside, switch to a view from its eyes, showing the landscape from its height. Twist: the animal's eyes follow wherever the user was looking before entering.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一只带门的巨型 AR 动物；当用户走进去，切换到它眼睛的视角，以它的高度观看风景；变体：动物的眼睛会看向用户进入前正在看的方向。

works.title: Steelman
works.description: A 10-metre concrete bear holding a pillow under its arm stands in the Staalmanplein neighbourhood of Slotervaart, Amsterdam.
works.description_zh: 一只 10 米高、腋下夹着枕头的混凝土熊立在阿姆斯特丹斯洛特瓦特区的 Staalmanplein 社区中。
works.idea_en: A sleepy giant toy in a housing estate gives a neighbourhood a friendly mascot, a gentle model for community AR characters.
works.idea_zh: 住宅区里一只睡眼惺忪的巨型玩具熊为社区带来了友好的吉祥物，是社区 AR 角色的温和范本。
works.technique: The bear was cast in concrete in sections over a steel frame and finished on site.
works.technique_zh: 熊在钢框架上分段浇筑混凝土，并在现场完成修饰。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR mascot for your street that residents vote on, and place it where most neighbours pass. Twist: it yawns and goes to sleep at the neighbourhood's average bedtime.
works.exercise_zh: 为你所在的街道设计一个由居民投票选出的 AR 吉祥物，并把它放在大多数邻居经过的地方；变体：到了社区平均就寝时间，它会打哈欠睡去。

works.title: Giants: Kikito
works.description: A 20-metre photograph of a one-year-old boy, Kikito, peers over the US–Mexico border fence in Tecate, mounted on scaffolding on the Mexican side so he appears to look into the United States.
works.description_zh: 一张 20 米高的一岁男孩 Kikito 的照片在特卡特越过美墨边境墙向外张望；照片装在墨西哥一侧的脚手架上，看起来他正望向美国。
works.idea_en: A child's gaze across a wall turns a political barrier into a human moment, showing how an image aligned with a real structure can change its meaning.
works.idea_zh: 一个孩子越过墙的目光把政治屏障变成了人性的瞬间，说明与真实结构对齐的图像可以改变其意义。
works.technique: A cut-out photographic print was mounted on a scaffold structure behind the fence and aligned so the child appears to lean on it.
works.technique_zh: 剪裁好的照片印刷品安装在围栏后方的脚手架上，并经过对齐，使孩子看起来像是靠在围栏上。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR cut-out photo of a person behind a real wall or fence so that they appear to look over it at passers-by. Twist: the person's eyes follow whoever walks past.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的墙或围栏后放置一张巨大的 AR 人物剪影照片，让他看起来正越过墙望着路人；变体：人物的眼睛会跟随经过的人。

works.title: Women Are Heroes
works.description: In the favelas of Rio, the slums of Kibera and other places, JR pasted huge portraits of local women onto houses, stairways, trains and rooftops, so the community's faces cover the landscape.
works.description_zh: 在里约的贫民窟、内罗毕的基贝拉等地，JR 把当地女性的巨幅肖像贴在房屋、阶梯、火车和屋顶上，让社区自己的面孔覆盖整片地景。
works.idea_en: Pasting local faces on the architecture they live in gives a community authorship of the view, a model for participatory AR portraits.
works.idea_zh: 把当地人的面孔贴在他们居住的建筑上，让社区成为景观的作者，是参与式 AR 肖像的范本。
works.technique: Portraits of women's eyes and faces are printed in strips and pasted across many surfaces so they read as one image from a distance.
works.technique_zh: 女性的眼睛与面孔肖像被分条印刷，粘贴在许多表面上，从远处看连成一幅图像。
works.exercise_en: Take portraits of people on your street and in AR map their faces across the facades of the buildings they live or work in, split over several surfaces. Twist: the face assembles only from one viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 为你所在街道的人拍摄肖像，在 AR 中把他们的面孔跨越多个表面映射到他们居住或工作的建筑立面上；变体：面孔只从某一个视点才会拼合完整。

works.title: Inside Out Project
works.description: Funded by the TED Prize, Inside Out invites any community to send portraits that JR's team prints as posters, which people paste together on walls in their own town; over 500,000 people have taken part.
works.description_zh: 由 TED 奖资助的 Inside Out 项目邀请任何社区寄来肖像，JR 的团队把它们印成海报，由人们在自己的城镇墙上一起张贴；已有超过五十万人参与。
works.idea_en: A simple, repeatable format that anyone can deploy turns an artwork into a global platform, the dream of every social AR template.
works.idea_zh: 一个任何人都能部署的简单、可复制的形式，把一件作品变成了全球平台，这是每个社交 AR 模板的梦想。
works.technique: A photo-booth truck prints large black-and-white portraits on the spot; participants paste them with wheat paste.
works.technique_zh: 照相亭卡车现场打印大幅黑白肖像，参与者用面粉浆把它们贴上墙。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebAR 'photo booth' that turns a selfie into a black-and-white poster and pins it to a shared wall anchor where every visitor's poster accumulates. Twist: the wall shows only faces of people who are nearby right now.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 WebAR“照相亭”，把自拍变成黑白海报并钉到一个共享的墙面锚点上，所有访客的海报在此累积；变体：墙上只显示此刻就在附近的人的面孔。

works.title: JR au Louvre
works.description: JR covered I. M. Pei's glass pyramid at the Louvre with a black-and-white photograph of the palace behind it, so from one point in the courtyard the pyramid seems to disappear.
works.description_zh: JR 用身后宫殿的黑白照片覆盖了贝聿铭设计的卢浮宫玻璃金字塔，于是从庭院中的某个位置看过去，金字塔仿佛消失了。
works.idea_en: Printing the background onto the object makes it vanish from one viewpoint: the physical version of diminished reality in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把背景印在物体上，使它从某个视点看来消失：这是 AR“削减现实”的实体版本。
works.technique: A photograph of the facade behind the pyramid was printed in strips and pasted on the glass, aligned to one viewing position.
works.technique_zh: 把金字塔后方立面的照片分条印刷，贴在玻璃上，并与某个观看位置对齐。
works.exercise_en: Photograph the wall behind a real object (a pillar, a sign) and in AR wrap the object with that photo so it disappears from one point. Twist: reveal the object again with a slow wipe when the user steps off the point.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下真实物体（柱子、标牌）背后的墙，在 AR 中用这张照片包裹物体，使其从某个位置看来消失；变体：当用户离开该位置时，用缓慢擦除的方式让物体重新显现。

works.title: The Secret of the Great Pyramid
works.description: For the pyramid's 30th anniversary, 400 volunteers pasted 2,000 paper strips across the Louvre's Napoleon courtyard; from above, the pyramid seems to rise out of a deep rocky quarry.
works.description_zh: 为纪念金字塔落成 30 周年，400 名志愿者在卢浮宫拿破仑庭院铺贴了 2000 条纸带；从高处看，金字塔仿佛从一座深深的岩石采石场中升起。
works.idea_en: An anamorphic ground image that reveals depth from one viewpoint is the analogue ancestor of AR depth illusions, and it dissolved as people walked on it.
works.idea_zh: 一幅从某个视点显出深度的变形地面图像，是 AR 深度错觉的模拟祖先，并随着人们在上面行走而逐渐消解。
works.technique: A photograph of rock was distorted to match the viewing angle from above and printed on paper strips glued to the paving.
works.technique_zh: 岩石照片按照上方观看角度进行变形，打印在纸条上并粘贴在地面上。
works.exercise_en: Create an anamorphic 'hole' image for a courtyard floor with a projection camera in Blender, print or display it in AR, and test the view from a balcony. Twist: let people's footsteps erase the image as they walk on it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 中用投影相机为庭院地面制作一幅变形“深坑”图像，在 AR 中显示并从阳台测试观看效果；变体：人们走在上面时，脚步会把图像擦掉。

works.title: La Ferita (The Wound)
works.description: On the facade of Palazzo Strozzi in Florence, a 28-metre collage appears to tear open the stone to reveal the courtyard, the library and Renaissance halls inside, a comment on museums closed during the pandemic.
works.description_zh: 在佛罗伦萨斯特罗齐宫的立面上，一幅 28 米高的拼贴仿佛把石墙撕开，露出内部的庭院、图书馆和文艺复兴大厅，影射疫情期间关闭的博物馆。
works.idea_en: A fake tear in a real wall that shows the interior is exactly an AR portal, done in paper.
works.idea_zh: 真实墙面上一道显露内部的假裂口，正是用纸做成的 AR 传送门。
works.technique: Photographs of the interior were composed into an anamorphic image aligned to the street view and pasted over the facade.
works.technique_zh: 把内部照片合成为与街道视角对齐的变形图像，并贴在立面上。
works.exercise_en: In AR, cut a jagged opening in a real wall with a depth mask and show a photo sphere of what is actually behind it (the room on the other side). Twist: the tear widens the longer you stand in front of it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用深度遮罩在真实墙面上切出一道参差的开口，显示墙后真实存在的内容（另一侧房间）的全景照片；变体：你在它面前站得越久，裂口就越宽。

works.title: Giants, Rio 2016
works.description: During the Rio Olympics, JR installed giant photographs of athletes on scaffolds across the city, such as a high jumper appearing to leap over a building.
works.description_zh: 里约奥运会期间，JR 在城市各处的脚手架上安装运动员的巨幅照片，例如一位跳高运动员仿佛从一栋建筑上方跃过。
works.idea_en: A body frozen in mid-action at the scale of a building makes the city part of the movement, a trick for AR motion stills.
works.idea_zh: 一个在动作中被定格、尺度与建筑相当的身体，让城市成为动作的一部分，这是 AR 动作定格的技巧。
works.technique: Cut-out photographic prints were mounted on scaffolding and positioned so the athlete appears to interact with real buildings.
works.technique_zh: 剪裁的照片印刷品安装在脚手架上，并经过定位，使运动员看起来与真实建筑产生互动。
works.exercise_en: Capture a classmate mid-jump with body segmentation and place the cut-out at building scale so they appear to leap over a real rooftop in AR. Twist: shoot a sequence and play it as a slow flip-book as the viewer walks along the street.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割捕捉一位同学跳跃的瞬间，把剪影以建筑尺度放置，让他在 AR 中看起来正跃过真实屋顶；变体：拍一组连续画面，让观者沿街行走时像慢速翻页书一样播放。

works.title: Tehachapi
works.description: In the yard of a maximum-security prison in Tehachapi, California, JR and inmates pasted a huge collage of prisoners' and guards' portraits on the ground, visible from the sky.
works.description_zh: 在加州特哈查皮一所最高安全级别监狱的放风场里，JR 与囚犯们在地面上贴出由囚犯和狱警肖像组成的巨大拼贴，从空中可见。
works.idea_en: An image made for the view from above, in a place people cannot leave, lets people be seen by the world; AR can give voice to spaces that are otherwise closed.
works.idea_zh: 一幅为俯视视角而作、位于人们无法离开之地的图像，让里面的人被世界看见；AR 可以为原本封闭的空间发声。
works.technique: Portrait strips were pasted over the yard's ground by participants following a grid, then photographed from a drone.
works.technique_zh: 参与者依照网格把肖像条贴满放风场地面，再由无人机拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Design a large ground collage of portraits in AR for a place with restricted access (a courtyard, a rooftop) and share only the aerial view publicly. Twist: each portrait speaks a sentence when you stand on it.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个限制进入的地方（庭院、屋顶）设计一幅大型地面肖像 AR 拼贴，只公开分享俯视画面；变体：当你站在某张肖像上时，它会说出一句话。

works.title: Face 2 Face
works.description: With Marco, JR pasted pairs of huge portraits of Israelis and Palestinians doing the same job, pulling funny faces side by side, on both sides of the separation wall and in eight cities.
works.description_zh: JR 与 Marco 合作，把从事同样职业的以色列人和巴勒斯坦人做鬼脸的巨幅肖像成对并排张贴在隔离墙两侧以及八座城市中。
works.idea_en: Putting two faces side by side that people expect to see apart creates empathy, a pairing strategy AR face filters rarely use.
works.idea_zh: 把人们以为应该分开的两张脸并排放在一起，会引发共情，这是 AR 人脸滤镜很少使用的配对策略。
works.technique: Portraits taken with a wide-angle lens close up are printed large and pasted in pairs.
works.technique_zh: 用广角镜头近距离拍摄的肖像被大幅打印后成对张贴。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR wall where two users in different places each add a funny-face portrait that is pasted side by side. Twist: pair people only when they have the same job or hobby.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一面 AR 墙，让身处不同地方的两位用户各自添加一张鬼脸肖像，并排贴在一起；变体：只有职业或爱好相同的人才会被配对。

works.title: Eiffel Tower anamorphosis (Trocadéro)
works.description: On the Trocadéro esplanade in Paris, a giant ground collage makes the Eiffel Tower appear to stand on the edge of a rocky cliff when photographed from the right spot.
works.description_zh: 在巴黎特罗卡德罗广场，一幅巨大的地面拼贴让埃菲尔铁塔在正确位置拍摄时看起来像是立在岩石悬崖边上。
works.idea_en: A single viewpoint turns a flat print into a cliff that swallows a monument; AR can use the same 'magic spot' to guide where people stand.
works.idea_zh: 一个特定视点把平面印刷品变成吞噬纪念碑的悬崖；AR 也可以用同样的“魔法点”引导人们站在哪里。
works.technique: Rock photographs were distorted for one camera position and pasted in strips on the paving in front of the tower.
works.technique_zh: 岩石照片按一个相机位置进行变形，分条粘贴在铁塔前的地面上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a landmark visible from campus and design an AR ground illusion that makes it look like it sits on the edge of a chasm from one marked spot. Twist: the chasm grows until someone steps into the frame.
works.exercise_zh: 选一座校园可见的地标，设计一个 AR 地面错觉，让它从一个标记点看过去像是立在深渊边缘；变体：深渊不断扩大，直到有人走进画面。

works.title: La Caverne du Pont Neuf
works.description: Paris's oldest bridge, the Pont Neuf, is covered by an inflated structure printed with rock, so the bridge seems to have vanished into a cave; the AR companion is listed separately as Echoes (Paris AR Studio).
works.description_zh: 巴黎最古老的桥梁新桥被一座印有岩石图案的充气结构覆盖，桥仿佛消失在一个洞穴中；其 AR 配套作品另行收录为 Echoes（Paris AR Studio）。
works.idea_en: Turning a bridge into a cave is world replacement at city scale, and pairing it with a phone lens shows how physical and AR layers can tell one story.
works.idea_zh: 把一座桥变成洞穴，是城市尺度的“替换世界”，再配上手机滤镜，展示了实体图层与 AR 图层如何讲同一个故事。
works.technique: A large inflatable envelope printed with rock imagery is fitted over the bridge and walkway (timelapse footage by AP).
works.technique_zh: 一个印有岩石图像的大型充气外壳覆盖在桥体和步道上（美联社拍摄的延时影像）。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small bridge or passage on campus and in AR replace its surfaces with a cave material, adding dripping sounds inside. Twist: the cave grows stalactites the longer the bridge is empty.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描校园里的一座小桥或通道，在 AR 中把它的表面换成洞穴材质，并在里面加入滴水声；变体：桥上无人的时间越长，洞里的钟乳石长得越多。

works.title: GROW
works.description: A 20,000-square-metre field of leeks in the Netherlands is lit at night with moving red and blue light, a recipe that can boost plant growth and reduce pesticide use, making farming visible as art.
works.description_zh: 荷兰一片两万平方米的韭葱田在夜间被移动的红蓝光照亮，这种光配方可以促进植物生长、减少农药使用，让农业作为艺术被看见。
works.idea_en: Lighting a working landscape shows the hidden value of a place people normally drive past, a strong brief for AR in agriculture.
works.idea_zh: 照亮一片正在生产的土地，展示了人们通常驾车而过的地方的隐藏价值，是农业 AR 的有力命题。
works.technique: Linear lights sweep over the crop rows in patterns based on research into light recipes for plant growth.
works.technique_zh: 线性灯光按照植物生长光配方研究的图案扫过作物行。
works.exercise_en: In AR, sweep coloured light bars across a real lawn or garden and label each plant bed with its growth data. Twist: the light speeds up where plants need more care.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让彩色光带扫过真实的草坪或花园，并为每块苗床标注生长数据；变体：植物越需要照料的地方，光带移动得越快。

works.title: Van Gogh Path
works.description: In Nuenen, where Van Gogh lived, a one-kilometre bicycle path is inlaid with thousands of stones that charge in daylight and glow at night in swirls inspired by The Starry Night.
works.description_zh: 在梵高曾经生活的纽南，一条一公里长的自行车道镶嵌着成千上万颗白天吸收光、夜间发光的石子，形成受《星月夜》启发的漩涡图案。
works.idea_en: A path that becomes a painting when you ride it at night ties art to movement and route, a model for AR guidance lines with character.
works.idea_zh: 一条在夜间骑行时就变成画作的小路，把艺术与移动和路线联系起来，是有个性的 AR 引导线的范本。
works.technique: Glow-in-the-dark stones and solar-powered LEDs are set into the path surface in a swirl pattern.
works.technique_zh: 夜光石和太阳能 LED 以漩涡图案嵌入路面。
works.exercise_en: Draw a glowing AR path that swirls along a real footpath and brightens under each walker's feet. Twist: the pattern is generated from a famous painting chosen by the user.
works.exercise_zh: 沿一条真实的步道画出一条旋转发光的 AR 小路，在每位行人脚下变亮；变体：图案由用户选择的一幅名画生成。

works.title: The Silent Evolution (MUSA)
works.description: Over 400 life-size figures cast from people of a local fishing village stand on the sea floor off Cancún, Mexico, in the Museo Subacuático de Arte, slowly covered by coral and algae.
works.description_zh: 400 多个以当地渔村居民为原型翻制的等身人像立在墨西哥坎昆外海的海底（Museo Subacuático de Arte），慢慢被珊瑚和藻类覆盖。
works.idea_en: A crowd that nature slowly transforms makes time and ecology visible, a model for AR figures that age with their environment.
works.idea_zh: 一群被自然慢慢改变的人像让时间和生态变得可见，是随环境老化的 AR 人像范本。
works.technique: Figures are cast in marine-grade cement that encourages coral growth and sunk onto the sea floor to divert divers from natural reefs.
works.technique_zh: 人像用利于珊瑚生长的海洋级水泥浇筑，沉入海底，以把潜水者从天然珊瑚礁引开。
works.exercise_en: Scan ten people and place them as an AR crowd in a pond or pool, then add a 'growth' shader that covers them with coral textures a little more each day. Twist: the growth speed follows real sea temperature data.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描十个人，把他们作为 AR 人群放在池塘或泳池中，并加入每天多覆盖一点珊瑚纹理的“生长”着色器；变体：生长速度跟随真实海温数据。

works.title: Ocean Atlas
works.description: Off Nassau in the Bahamas, a 5-metre, 60-ton figure of a local girl kneels on the sea floor and holds up the surface of the ocean on her back.
works.description_zh: 在巴哈马拿骚外海，一个 5 米高、重 60 吨、以当地女孩为原型的人像跪在海底，用背托起海面。
works.idea_en: A figure that carries the boundary between two worlds (water and air) is a strong image for AR works that sit on a surface between realities.
works.idea_zh: 一个托起两个世界（水与空气）之间边界的人像，是位于现实之间表面上的 AR 作品的有力意象。
works.technique: The sculpture was cast in sections of pH-neutral cement and assembled on the sea floor by divers and a crane barge.
works.technique_zh: 雕塑以 pH 中性水泥分段浇筑，由潜水员和起重驳船在海底组装。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR figure under a real table or water surface so it appears to hold it up, using the table plane as an occlusion boundary. Twist: when the user places objects on the table, the figure strains more.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 AR 人像放在真实的桌面或水面下方，让它看起来正托着这个面，并以桌面平面作为遮挡边界；变体：当用户往桌上放东西时，人像会显得更吃力。

works.title: Museo Atlántico
works.description: Europe's first underwater museum off Lanzarote holds works such as The Rubicon, a line of figures walking toward a gate, and a raft of refugees, 12 metres below the surface.
works.description_zh: 位于兰萨罗特岛外海、欧洲首座水下博物馆收藏着《The Rubicon》（一列走向一扇门的人像）和一艘难民木筏等作品，位于水下 12 米。
works.idea_en: A procession of figures walking toward a threshold turns the sea floor into a narrative scene, a pattern for AR storytelling with frozen crowds.
works.idea_zh: 一列走向门槛的人像把海底变成叙事场景，这是用凝固人群讲故事的 AR 模式。
works.technique: Figures cast from local people are fixed to the sandy floor in groups and arranged as scenes.
works.technique_zh: 以当地人为原型翻制的人像成组固定在沙质海底上，排列成场景。
works.exercise_en: Arrange a frozen AR procession of scanned people walking toward a real doorway on campus. Twist: the procession advances one step each time a real person walks through the door.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里安排一列扫描人像组成的凝固 AR 队伍，走向一扇真实的门；变体：每有一个真人穿过这扇门，队伍就前进一步。

works.title: Coral Greenhouse
works.description: At the Museum of Underwater Art on the Great Barrier Reef, a steel greenhouse on the sea floor contains figures of students tending coral, designed as a nursery for reef life.
works.description_zh: 在大堡礁的水下艺术博物馆，一座海底钢结构温室中有学生照料珊瑚的人像，被设计为珊瑚礁生物的育苗场。
works.idea_en: A human-made structure designed to be colonised by life flips the relation between architecture and nature, a thought for AR spaces that host real processes.
works.idea_zh: 一个为了被生命占据而设计的人造结构，颠倒了建筑与自然的关系，这为承载真实过程的 AR 空间提供了思考。
works.technique: A marine-grade stainless steel and cement frame was sunk at John Brewer Reef, with planting trays for coral fragments.
works.technique_zh: 海洋级不锈钢与水泥框架沉放在 John Brewer 礁，设有供珊瑚碎片生长的种植托盘。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR greenhouse frame over a real garden bed or pot plant and log real observations (height, leaves) as notes attached to it. Twist: the virtual frame fills in with glass panels as the real plant grows.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实的花坛或盆栽上放一个 AR 温室框架，并把真实观察（高度、叶子数）作为附注记录在上面；变体：随着真实植物生长，虚拟框架逐渐装上玻璃板。

works.title: Stickwork
works.description: At the Peabody Essex Museum, Dougherty and volunteers weave thousands of saplings into swirling hut-like forms that look like windblown drawings in 3D.
works.description_zh: 在皮博迪埃塞克斯博物馆，Dougherty 与志愿者把数千根树苗编成旋转的小屋状形体，看起来像被风吹动的三维素描。
works.idea_en: Line drawn in space with natural material shows how volumetric sketching can make architecture; AR 3D drawing apps can reach the same feeling.
works.idea_zh: 用自然材料在空间中画线，展示了体积化素描如何成为建筑；AR 三维绘画应用也能达到同样的感觉。
works.technique: Flexible saplings are bent and interwoven over a rough frame, with the outer layer of sticks laid in one direction to suggest motion.
works.technique_zh: 柔韧的树苗在粗略的框架上弯曲交织，外层枝条朝同一方向铺设，以暗示运动感。
works.exercise_en: Use a 3D drawing tool (Open Brush in passthrough or a WebXR line tool) to weave a hut-sized structure over a real bench or tree with a team. Twist: every stroke must follow the direction of the real wind.
works.exercise_zh: 用三维绘画工具（透视模式下的 Open Brush 或 WebXR 画线工具）与团队一起在真实的长椅或树上编出一个小屋大小的结构；变体：每一笔都必须顺着真实的风向。

works.title: Forest Giants (Bernheim Forest)
works.description: Three giant trolls built from scrap wood (a mother and two children) sit and lie along trails in Bernheim Forest, Kentucky, found by hikers exploring the woods.
works.description_zh: 三个用废木料搭建的巨型巨魔（一位母亲和两个孩子）坐卧在肯塔基州 Bernheim 森林的小径旁，等待徒步者在林中发现。
works.idea_en: Characters hidden along trails turn a walk into a search, the physical version of an AR scavenger hunt.
works.idea_zh: 藏在小径旁的角色把散步变成了寻找，是 AR 寻宝游戏的实体版本。
works.technique: Pallets and scrap wood are cut and screwed onto a timber frame, with faces sculpted from branches, built with local volunteers.
works.technique_zh: 托盘和废木料被切割并用螺丝固定在木框架上，面部用树枝塑造，由当地志愿者协助建造。
works.exercise_en: Hide three AR characters in a park with Niantic Lightship or 8th Wall, each with a riddle pointing to the next. Twist: each character only appears when the user is quiet (low microphone level).
works.exercise_zh: 用 Niantic Lightship 或 8th Wall 在公园里藏三个 AR 角色，每个都附有指向下一个的谜语；变体：只有当用户保持安静（麦克风音量低）时角色才会出现。

works.title: Long Leif, the biggest troll
works.description: In Minnesota, Dambo builds Long Leif, his biggest troll yet, as part of a trail of nine sculptures and 700 birdhouses made from recycled materials.
works.description_zh: 在明尼苏达州，Dambo 建造了他迄今最大的巨魔 Long Leif，这是由回收材料制成的九座雕塑和 700 个鸟屋组成的路线的一部分。
works.idea_en: A network of characters with a story across a region shows how to design a multi-site AR world with one mythology.
works.idea_zh: 一整个地区里带有故事的角色网络，展示了如何用一套神话设计多地点 AR 世界。
works.technique: Large timber frames are clad with reclaimed wood; birdhouses from recycled materials are placed along the trail.
works.technique_zh: 大型木框架覆以回收木料；用回收材料制作的鸟屋沿路线安放。
works.exercise_en: Write a short myth for your neighbourhood and place its characters as AR figures at five real locations, with a map. Twist: add AR birdhouses that real birds' sounds can 'move into' when recorded nearby.
works.exercise_zh: 为你的社区写一个短神话，把其中角色作为 AR 人物放在五个真实地点，并配一张地图；变体：加入 AR 鸟屋，当附近录到真实鸟鸣时，“鸟”就会住进去。

works.title: Rose Wonders (Burning Man)
works.description: At Burning Man 2025 in the Nevada desert, Dambo's biggest sculpture yet, Rose Wonders, is a giant wooden troll figure in the playa, introduced with a poem.
works.description_zh: 在 2025 年内华达沙漠的火人节上，Dambo 迄今最大的雕塑《Rose Wonders》是一个伫立在干湖床上的巨型木制巨魔，并配有一首诗。
works.idea_en: A giant character in an empty desert becomes a gathering point for a temporary city, a model for AR landmarks at festivals.
works.idea_zh: 空旷沙漠中的巨型角色成为一座临时城市的聚集点，是节庆 AR 地标的范本。
works.technique: A large wooden structure of recycled timber was prefabricated and assembled on the playa.
works.technique_zh: 用回收木材制作的大型木结构经预制后在干湖床上组装。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR landmark character for a school festival that everyone can find from any point on the site and that recites a short poem when approached. Twist: add one line to the poem for every visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 为学校活动设计一个 AR 地标角色，场地任何位置都能看到它，靠近时它会朗诵一首短诗；变体：每来一位访客，诗就增加一行。

works.title: Cement Eclipses (Utsira)
works.description: On the Norwegian island of Utsira, Cordal places tiny cement figures of office workers on rocks, puddles and ledges, lost in a vast natural landscape.
works.description_zh: 在挪威乌特西拉岛上，Cordal 把小小的水泥上班族人偶放在岩石、水洼和岩架上，迷失在广阔的自然风景中。
works.idea_en: Tiny figures in a huge landscape reverse the usual scale, making viewers crouch and look closely, as small AR figures do.
works.idea_zh: 广阔风景中的微小人偶颠倒了通常的尺度，让观众蹲下细看，小型 AR 人偶也是如此。
works.technique: Figures are cast in cement from small sculpted models and placed on site, then photographed at ground level.
works.technique_zh: 人偶由雕塑小样翻模浇筑成水泥，放置到现场后贴地拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Place 10 tiny AR office workers on real rocks, puddles and kerbs, with occlusion so they hide behind real objects, and photograph them at ground level. Twist: they form a queue that moves toward the nearest puddle.
works.exercise_zh: 把 10 个微型 AR 上班族放在真实的石头、水洼和路缘上，并开启遮挡让它们躲在真实物体后面，贴地拍摄；变体：它们排成队伍，朝最近的水洼移动。

works.title: Cement Eclipses (Málaga)
works.description: In the streets of Málaga, tiny cement figures appear in gutters, on cornices and bus shelters, acting out scenes of city life that most passers-by miss.
works.description_zh: 在马拉加的街头，小小的水泥人偶出现在排水沟、檐口和公交候车亭上，演绎着大多数路人都会错过的城市生活场景。
works.idea_en: Small interventions that reward attention are a subtle alternative to loud AR content.
works.idea_zh: 奖励细心观察的小型介入，是喧闹 AR 内容之外的一种含蓄选择。
works.technique: Figures are glued or placed on urban surfaces at eye level or below, composed into small scenes.
works.technique_zh: 人偶被粘贴或放置在视线高度或以下的城市表面上，组成小场景。
works.exercise_en: Create five tiny AR scenes anchored to street furniture (bins, drains, railings) with image markers or plane detection. Twist: each scene is only visible when the phone is held below knee height.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像标记或平面检测，在街道设施（垃圾桶、排水口、栏杆）上锚定五个微型 AR 场景；变体：只有当手机低于膝盖高度时，场景才可见。

works.title: Little People
works.description: Hand-painted model-railway figures are left in London's streets in tiny scenes (a man fishing in a drain, a couple on a crisp packet) and photographed close-up, then left to be found or lost.
works.description_zh: 手绘的火车模型小人被留在伦敦街头的微型场景中（在排水口钓鱼的男人、坐在薯片袋上的情侣），被近距离拍摄后，便任人发现或遗失。
works.idea_en: Street details become full stories at 1:87 scale; AR can re-scale everyday surfaces into worlds in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 街头细节在 1:87 的尺度下成了完整的故事；AR 也能以同样方式把日常表面重新缩放成一个个世界。
works.technique: Commercial model figures are repainted and modified, placed in real street settings and photographed with a macro lens.
works.technique_zh: 商业模型人偶经过重新上色和改造，放在真实街景中，用微距镜头拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Scan or model tiny AR people and stage a story on a real kerb, drain or leaf, then take a macro-style AR photo. Twist: the scene reacts to real rain by opening tiny umbrellas.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描或建模微型 AR 小人，在真实的路缘、排水口或树叶上布置一个故事，并拍一张微距风格的 AR 照片；变体：场景会对真实下雨作出反应，撑起小伞。

works.title: Les Voyageurs
works.description: Life-size bronze travellers carrying suitcases are missing large parts of their torsos, so the harbour behind them shows through; the video shows them at the port of Étaples.
works.description_zh: 等身青铜旅人拎着行李箱，身体大块缺失，身后的港口从中透出；视频展示了它们在埃塔普勒港的样子。
works.idea_en: The missing body is filled by the real landscape: the most direct physical example of diminished reality and see-through AR.
works.idea_zh: 缺失的身体由真实风景填补：这是“削减现实”和透视 AR 最直接的实体例子。
works.technique: Figures are modelled in clay, cast in bronze and cut away, with the remaining parts supported through the suitcase and legs.
works.technique_zh: 人像以黏土塑造后铸成青铜，再切去部分，剩余部分通过行李箱和双腿支撑。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR human figure on a street and cut a large hole through its body with a mask, so the real street shows through. Twist: the hole grows as the figure 'travels' further from home (GPS distance).
works.exercise_zh: 在街上放置一个 AR 人像，用遮罩在其身体上切出一个大洞，让真实街道透出来；变体：人像离“家”越远（按 GPS 距离），洞就越大。

works.title: Street installations
works.description: Life-size figures cast in packing tape and dressed in real clothes are placed in odd situations in the street (head in a wall, lying in a fountain); the video shows his piece for Nuit Blanche Paris 2014.
works.description_zh: 用封箱胶带翻制、穿着真衣服的等身人像被放在街头的奇怪情境中（头插进墙里、躺在喷泉中）；视频展示了他为 2014 年巴黎 Nuit Blanche 创作的作品。
works.idea_en: Realistic bodies in impossible poses test people's reactions, which is the social experiment behind every public AR character.
works.idea_zh: 以不可能的姿势出现的逼真身体测试了人们的反应，这正是每个公共 AR 角色背后的社会实验。
works.technique: Tape is wrapped around a model's body (sticky side out, then over), cut off and reassembled, then dressed and placed.
works.technique_zh: 用胶带缠绕模特身体（先粘面朝外，再覆盖一层），剪下后重新拼合，穿上衣服后放置到位。
works.exercise_en: Place a photoreal AR person in an absurd pose (half inside a wall, face down in a planter) and record passers-by through the phone. Twist: the figure changes pose when nobody is looking.
works.exercise_zh: 放置一个以荒诞姿势出现的逼真 AR 人物（半截身子在墙里、脸朝下埋在花盆里），并通过手机记录路人反应；变体：没人看时人物会改变姿势。

works.title: Support
works.description: Two giant white hands rise out of the Grand Canal in Venice to hold up the side of the Ca' Sagredo Hotel, a warning about rising seas and climate change.
works.description_zh: 一双巨大的白色手从威尼斯大运河中伸出，托住 Ca' Sagredo 酒店的侧墙，警示海平面上升与气候变化。
works.idea_en: Giant hands that seem to hold up a real building make a warning feel physical, a strong idea for AR interaction with architecture.
works.idea_zh: 仿佛托住真实建筑的巨手让警示变得具体可感，是 AR 与建筑互动的有力创意。
works.technique: Scanned hands of the artist's son were enlarged, built in resin over a steel core and anchored in the canal bed.
works.technique_zh: 艺术家儿子的手经扫描放大，以树脂覆盖钢芯制成，锚固在运河河床上。
works.exercise_en: Use hand tracking to capture a pair of hands, enlarge them in AR and place them rising out of the ground to 'hold up' a real building. Twist: the hands tremble more as a live sea-level or temperature value rises.
works.exercise_zh: 用手部追踪捕捉一双手，在 AR 中放大，让它们从地面伸出“托住”一栋真实建筑；变体：实时海平面或气温数值越高，双手颤抖得越厉害。

works.title: Building Bridges
works.description: For the 2019 Venice Biennale, six pairs of giant hands arch over the water of the Arsenale basin to meet, each pair standing for a universal value such as friendship, wisdom or hope.
works.description_zh: 为 2019 年威尼斯双年展，六对巨手在军械库水池上方拱起相握，每一对代表一种普世价值，如友谊、智慧或希望。
works.idea_en: Hands reaching across water to meet make a bridge out of a gesture, a model for shared AR interactions between two sides of a space.
works.idea_zh: 隔水伸出、在中间相握的手用一个手势搭起了桥，是空间两侧之间共享 AR 互动的范本。
works.technique: Six pairs of hands, 15 metres tall, were cast in sections and installed on foundations on both sides of the basin.
works.technique_zh: 六对 15 米高的手分段浇筑，安装在水池两侧的基础上。
works.exercise_en: Let two users on opposite sides of a courtyard each reach out with tracked hands; their giant AR hands meet in the middle only when both reach at the same time. Twist: each pair of hands is labelled with a value the users choose together.
works.exercise_zh: 让庭院两侧的两位用户各自用被追踪的手向前伸出；只有两人同时伸手时，他们的巨型 AR 手才会在中间相握；变体：每对手都标注一个由两位用户共同选择的价值。

works.title: From the knees of my nose to the belly of my toes
works.description: The whole brick facade of a derelict house in Margate appears to slide off the building and slump into the front garden, while the house stays intact behind it.
works.description_zh: 马盖特一座废弃房屋的整面砖墙立面仿佛从楼上滑落、堆倒在前院里，而房屋本身在后面完好无损。
works.idea_en: Deforming a real facade with real materials is exactly what AR 'melt' filters do digitally, and it shows how much credibility depends on material detail.
works.idea_zh: 用真实材料让真实立面变形，正是 AR“融化”滤镜用数字方式做的事，也说明可信度有多依赖材质细节。
works.technique: A new brick skin was built on a hidden steel frame in a sliding curve, with real windows and doors bent to follow it.
works.technique_zh: 在隐藏的钢框架上砌出一层呈滑落曲线的新砖墙，并让真实的门窗随之弯曲。
works.exercise_en: Use a facade-tracking or scanned-building AR setup to make a real house front slide down into the garden with a physics animation. Twist: let the user push it back up by swiping.
works.exercise_zh: 用立面追踪或扫描建筑的 AR 方案，让真实房屋的立面带着物理动画滑落到院子里；变体：让用户通过滑动把它推回原位。

works.title: Take my lightning but don't steal my thunder
works.description: In Covent Garden Piazza, the top half of a classical stone building appears to float in the air, cut cleanly from its base, with no visible support.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦 Covent Garden 广场，一座古典石头建筑的上半部分似乎被整齐地切离底座，漂浮在空中，看不到任何支撑。
works.idea_en: A levitating building is a classic AR demo made physical; the hidden support shows how illusions depend on concealed anchors.
works.idea_zh: 一栋悬浮的建筑是经典 AR 演示的实体版；隐藏的支撑说明了错觉如何依赖被遮蔽的锚点。
works.technique: The upper section is built on a single hidden steel support concealed within the gap and the building's structure.
works.technique_zh: 上半部分依靠一根隐藏在缝隙和建筑结构中的钢支撑建造。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small building or kiosk and make its top half lift off and float in AR, leaving a clean cut. Twist: the gap widens as more people stand underneath.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一座小建筑或售货亭，在 AR 中让它的上半部分抬起漂浮，留下整齐的切口；变体：站在下面的人越多，缝隙越宽。

works.title: A pound of flesh for 50p
works.description: A house built from 7,000 wax bricks slowly melts over a month in London, its walls and roof sagging until the structure collapses.
works.description_zh: 一座由 7000 块蜡砖砌成的房子在伦敦用一个月慢慢融化，墙和屋顶逐渐塌陷，直到整个结构倒塌。
works.idea_en: A building that changes over weeks makes time the material, a model for AR structures that decay slowly across visits.
works.idea_zh: 一座在数周内持续变化的建筑把时间变成了材料，是跨多次到访缓慢衰败的 AR 结构的范本。
works.technique: Bricks cast in wax are laid like normal masonry and heated from inside so the house deforms gradually.
works.technique_zh: 蜡制砖块像普通砖一样砌筑，从内部加热，使房屋逐渐变形。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR house on campus that melts a little each day using a vertex-displacement shader driven by the day count. Twist: speed up the melting on hotter days using live temperature.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里搭建一座 AR 房屋，用由天数驱动的顶点位移着色器让它每天融化一点；变体：用实时气温让它在热天融化得更快。

works.title: Discovering Columbus
works.description: Around the statue of Christopher Columbus in New York's Columbus Circle, Nishi built a fully furnished living room six storeys up, so visitors met the statue at eye level beside a sofa and TV.
works.description_zh: 在纽约哥伦布圆环的哥伦布雕像周围，Nishi 在六层楼高处搭建了一个陈设齐全的客厅，让访客在沙发和电视旁与雕像平视相遇。
works.idea_en: Changing the room around a monument changes what it means; AR portals can wrap a statue in an unexpected interior the same way.
works.idea_zh: 改变纪念碑周围的房间就改变了它的意义；AR 传送门也可以同样用一个意想不到的室内空间包裹雕像。
works.technique: A scaffold tower supports a room built around the top of the column, decorated with custom wallpaper and furniture.
works.technique_zh: 脚手架塔支撑着一个围绕柱顶搭建的房间，配以定制墙纸和家具。
works.exercise_en: Choose a statue and build an AR room around its head (walls, sofa, lamp) so a viewer standing on a bench is 'inside' with it. Twist: the wallpaper pattern tells the statue's history.
works.exercise_zh: 选择一座雕像，在它头部周围搭建一个 AR 房间（墙、沙发、台灯），让站在长椅上的观者与它同处“室内”；变体：墙纸图案讲述雕像的历史。

works.title: The Merlion Hotel
works.description: For the Singapore Biennale, Nishi built a hotel room around the Merlion statue, so guests could sleep next to the city's symbol and visitors could see it indoors.
works.description_zh: 为新加坡双年展，Nishi 围绕鱼尾狮雕像建了一间酒店客房，客人可以睡在城市象征的旁边，访客也能在室内看到它。
works.idea_en: Turning a public icon into a private room flips the scale of intimacy, a prompt for AR rooms built around landmarks.
works.idea_zh: 把公共偶像变成私人房间，翻转了亲密的尺度，这为围绕地标搭建的 AR 房间提供了启发。
works.technique: A temporary structure enclosed the statue with walls, a bed and a bathroom, open to visitors by day and guests by night.
works.technique_zh: 一个临时结构用墙、床和浴室把雕像围住，白天向访客开放，夜晚接待住客。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual bedroom around a campus landmark in AR so that the landmark sits by the bed. Twist: at night, the room's lights turn on and the landmark 'sleeps'.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中围绕校园地标放置一间虚拟卧室，让地标就在床边；变体：到了夜晚，房间的灯亮起，地标“入睡”。

works.title: RedBall Project
works.description: A 4.6-metre red inflatable ball is squeezed into alleys, archways, bridges and doorways, a new site each day, in cities from Barcelona to Sydney; Danny Cooke's film follows its UK tour.
works.description_zh: 一个直径 4.6 米的红色充气球被塞进小巷、拱门、桥梁和门洞，在从巴塞罗那到悉尼的城市中每天换一处；Danny Cooke 的影片跟随了它的英国巡回。
works.idea_en: One simple object that deforms to each site's geometry is the ideal spatial-mapping demo, and people come back daily to see where it goes next.
works.idea_zh: 一个会随每个场地几何形状变形的简单物体，是理想的空间映射示范，人们每天都回来看它下一次会去哪里。
works.technique: The ball is inflated in place so its soft skin presses against the surrounding architecture.
works.technique_zh: 球在现场充气，柔软的外皮紧贴周围的建筑。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit or AR Foundation mesh collision to squeeze a soft red AR ball into real doorways, gaps and corners so it deforms against real surfaces. Twist: publish a new location every day as a clue.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 或 AR Foundation 的网格碰撞，把一个柔软的红色 AR 球塞进真实的门洞、缝隙和角落，让它贴合真实表面变形；变体：每天发布一个新地点作为线索。

works.title: Spoonbridge and Cherry
works.description: A 15-metre spoon with a giant cherry in its bowl spans a pond in the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden; water sprays from the cherry's stem.
works.description_zh: 一把长 15 米、勺中盛着一颗巨大樱桃的勺子横跨明尼阿波利斯雕塑公园的池塘；水从樱桃梗中喷出。
works.idea_en: An everyday object at giant scale makes a whole garden feel like a tabletop, the most common and effective trick in consumer AR.
works.idea_zh: 一件被放大到巨大尺度的日常物品让整座花园像一张桌面，这是消费级 AR 中最常见也最有效的手法。
works.technique: The spoon is built of stainless steel on a hidden frame and the cherry of painted aluminium, with a fountain pipe inside.
works.technique_zh: 勺子由不锈钢在隐藏框架上制成，樱桃由涂漆铝制成，内部有喷泉管。
works.exercise_en: Scan a kitchen utensil and a fruit and place them at 15 metres across a real pond or lawn in AR. Twist: add a physics cherry that rolls off if someone 'bumps' the spoon.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一件厨房用具和一颗水果，在 AR 中把它们以 15 米的尺寸放在真实的池塘或草坪上；变体：加入一颗物理樱桃，有人“碰”到勺子时它就会滚落。

works.title: East-West/West-East
works.description: Four steel plates, each over 14 metres tall, stand in a line more than a kilometre long across a valley in the Brouq Nature Reserve in Qatar; their tops are level while the ground dips beneath them.
works.description_zh: 四块各高 14 米以上的钢板在卡塔尔 Brouq 自然保护区的一处山谷中排成一条长逾一公里的直线；钢板顶部齐平，而下方地面起伏下沉。
works.idea_en: Level tops over uneven ground turn a desert into a measuring device, a strong idea for AR objects that reveal terrain by staying level.
works.idea_zh: 起伏地面上齐平的顶部，把沙漠变成一件测量工具，这是通过保持水平来揭示地形的 AR 物体的有力创意。
works.technique: Plates of different heights were set in a surveyed line so that their tops share one elevation across the dip in the terrain.
works.technique_zh: 高度不一的钢板沿测量好的直线放置，使它们的顶端跨越地形凹陷保持同一海拔。
works.exercise_en: Place four tall AR slabs in a line across a sloping field with their tops locked to the same world height, and walk the line from end to end. Twist: add a fifth slab that the user places by eye, then check how far off it is.
works.exercise_zh: 在倾斜的场地上把四块高大的 AR 板排成一线，顶部锁定在同一世界高度，从一端走到另一端；变体：让用户凭目测放置第五块板，再检查偏差有多大。

works.title: Moerenuma Park
works.description: Designed by Noguchi before his death in 1988 and completed in 2005, Moerenuma Park in Sapporo turns a garbage landfill into a park of geometric hills, a glass pyramid, fountains and sculptural playgrounds.
works.description_zh: 由 Noguchi 在 1988 年去世前设计、2005 年完工的札幌 Moerenuma 公园，把一座垃圾填埋场变成由几何山丘、玻璃金字塔、喷泉和雕塑游乐场组成的公园。
works.idea_en: A whole park conceived as one sculpture shows how land shape itself can be the interface for play, a guide for AR in parks.
works.idea_zh: 把整座公园构想为一件雕塑，说明土地形态本身就可以是游戏的界面，这是公园 AR 的指南。
works.technique: The landfill was capped and reshaped with earth into cones, a mound and a pyramid, following Noguchi's model.
works.technique_zh: 填埋场被封盖，并按照 Noguchi 的模型用泥土重塑成圆锥、土丘和金字塔。
works.exercise_en: Model a small park of geometric AR hills and play objects on a flat lawn, then test with children how they move through it. Twist: the shapes subtly reshape toward where people walk most.
works.exercise_zh: 在平坦草坪上建模一座由几何 AR 山丘和游戏物件组成的小公园，并与孩子们一起测试他们如何在其中移动；变体：形体会悄悄朝人们最常走的方向重塑。

works.title: Fog Sculpture (Neue Nationalgalerie)
works.description: In the sculpture garden of the Neue Nationalgalerie in Berlin, clouds of pure water fog pour out at timed intervals, wrapping visitors, trees and Mies van der Rohe's building and drifting with the wind.
works.description_zh: 在柏林新国家美术馆的雕塑花园中，纯水雾按时喷出，包裹访客、树木和密斯·凡德罗的建筑，并随风飘移。
works.idea_en: Fog is a real volume that people walk into and that the weather shapes, the benchmark for any volumetric AR effect.
works.idea_zh: 雾是人们可以走进去、由天气塑造的真实体积，是所有体积化 AR 效果的标杆。
works.technique: High-pressure pumps push water through hundreds of tiny nozzles that create droplets small enough to hang in the air as fog.
works.technique_zh: 高压泵把水推过数百个微型喷嘴，产生细小到足以悬浮在空中形成雾的水滴。
works.exercise_en: Build a volumetric fog cloud in AR (raymarched or particle-based) that pours from a real bench at set times and drifts with live wind direction. Twist: the fog parts around people using body segmentation.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中制作一团体积雾（光线步进或粒子），按设定时间从一张真实长椅上涌出，并随实时风向飘移；变体：用人体分割让雾在人周围分开。

works.title: Intrude
works.description: Giant white inflatable rabbits, up to seven metres tall and lit from within, sit in public squares and parks around the world; the video shows them at Townsville's Ephemera festival.
works.description_zh: 高达七米、内部发光的巨型白色充气兔子坐落在世界各地的广场和公园中；视频展示的是它们在汤斯维尔 Ephemera 艺术节上的样子。
works.idea_en: Cute, glowing giants in a city at night are the simplest crowd-pleasing AR scene, and here they carry an ecological message.
works.idea_zh: 城市夜晚中可爱发光的巨型动物是最简单、最讨人喜欢的 AR 场景，而在这里它们还承载着生态信息。
works.technique: Nylon inflatables with internal lights are anchored in public spaces and inflated with fans.
works.technique_zh: 内置灯光的尼龙充气体固定在公共空间中，用风扇充气。
works.exercise_en: Place a group of glowing AR animals in a dark courtyard and give them a short message about a local invasive species. Twist: the animals multiply every hour, like the species itself.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗的庭院里放一群发光的 AR 动物，并为它们配上一段关于本地入侵物种的短信息；变体：动物每小时繁殖一次，就像那个物种本身。

works.title: Heartbeat (Invasions)
works.description: A 54-metre cloud of 100,000 white balloons fills the Covent Garden market hall in London, lit by a slow pulsing light like a heartbeat.
works.description_zh: 由十万只白色气球组成、长 54 米的云团填满伦敦 Covent Garden 市场大厅，被一束缓慢脉动的光照亮，犹如心跳。
works.idea_en: A mass of one simple element plus a slow pulse makes a building feel alive, a cheap and effective AR composition.
works.idea_zh: 一种简单元素的大量聚集，加上缓慢的脉动，让一栋建筑显得有生命，这是廉价又有效的 AR 构图。
works.technique: Balloons are tied into nets and suspended in the hall; a lighting system inside pulses on a heartbeat rhythm.
works.technique_zh: 气球被绑进网中悬挂在大厅内，内部的灯光系统按心跳节奏脉动。
works.exercise_en: Fill a real room or atrium with thousands of instanced AR balloons and pulse their brightness to the user's heart rate from a watch or camera. Twist: the balloons drift out of the building one by one when the room is empty.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间或中庭里填满数千只实例化 AR 气球，并按手表或相机测得的用户心率让其亮度脉动；变体：房间无人时，气球会一只只飘出建筑。

works.title: Siluetas
works.description: In Iowa and Mexico, Mendieta pressed, burned and planted the outline of her body into earth, sand, mud and rivers, recording the traces in photographs and films; the MoMA video introduces the series.
works.description_zh: 在艾奥瓦和墨西哥，Mendieta 把自己身体的轮廓压进、烧进或种进泥土、沙子、泥浆和河流中，并用照片和影片记录这些痕迹；MoMA 的视频介绍了这个系列。
works.idea_en: A body-shaped mark left in nature holds presence after the person has gone, a direct brief for AR silhouettes left at places.
works.idea_zh: 留在自然中的人形痕迹在人离开后仍保有“在场”，是在地点留下 AR 剪影的直接命题。
works.technique: She lay in the landscape or shaped her outline with flowers, gunpowder, mud or fire, then filmed the trace changing.
works.technique_zh: 她躺在风景中，或用花朵、火药、泥浆或火塑出自己的轮廓，然后拍摄痕迹的变化。
works.exercise_en: Capture your body outline with segmentation and leave it on the ground in AR, filled with a natural material (petals, fire, water). Twist: the silhouette is only visible to people who stand exactly where you lay.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割捕捉你的身体轮廓，在 AR 中把它留在地面上，并用自然材料（花瓣、火、水）填满；变体：只有站在你曾躺过的确切位置的人才能看到这个剪影。

works.title: Stellar Axis: Antarctica
works.description: Near the South Pole, Albuquerque led an expedition that placed 99 blue spheres on the ice, each at the position of a star in the sky above, making the first large ephemeral artwork on the continent.
works.description_zh: 在南极点附近，Albuquerque 带领考察队在冰面上放置了 99 个蓝色球体，每个都对应头顶天空中一颗星的位置，这是南极大陆上第一件大型短暂艺术作品。
works.idea_en: Mapping the sky onto the ground turns astronomy into a walkable place, a clear template for AR star maps anchored to terrain.
works.idea_zh: 把天空映射到地面，让天文学变成可以行走的地方，是锚定在地形上的 AR 星图的清晰模板。
works.technique: Fibreglass spheres of different sizes (by star brightness) were placed on the ice by GPS according to a projected star chart.
works.technique_zh: 大小不同（按星等）的玻璃钢球体依据投影星图，以 GPS 定位放置在冰面上。
works.exercise_en: Project tonight's star chart onto a field in AR, placing a sphere on the ground under each bright star, sized by magnitude. Twist: when the user looks up, draw a line from each sphere to its real star.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把今晚的星图投到操场上，在每颗亮星下方的地面上放一个球体，大小按星等决定；变体：当用户抬头时，从每个球体画一条线连到它对应的真实星星。

works.title: sanctuarium
works.description: For Skulptur Projekte Münster 1997, de Vries fenced a circle of land in a city park with a wall and left it untouched, so wild plants grew freely inside, visible only through small openings.
works.description_zh: 为 1997 年明斯特雕塑展，de Vries 在一座城市公园里用围墙圈出一块圆形土地，任其不受打扰，让野生植物在内部自由生长，只能透过小开口看到。
works.idea_en: Protecting a patch of nature and letting time do the work makes an invisible process the artwork, a stance for slow AR.
works.idea_zh: 保护一块自然之地、让时间去完成作品，把一个看不见的过程变成了艺术，这是慢节奏 AR 的立场。
works.technique: A round enclosure with a few viewing slits is built around a plot of land that is then left unmanaged for years.
works.technique_zh: 围绕一块土地建起带有几道观察缝的圆形围墙，然后多年不加管理。
works.exercise_en: Mark a small patch of real ground in AR with a virtual fence and log photos of it once a week to build a time-lapse. Twist: the virtual fence grows taller the longer the patch remains undisturbed.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用虚拟围栏标出一小块真实地面，每周拍照记录一次以制作延时影像；变体：这块地保持不受干扰的时间越长，虚拟围栏就长得越高。

works.title: Group Walk, Birmingham
works.description: At Curzon Park in Birmingham, Fulton led a group walk in which participants moved slowly along set lines, turning a derelict site into a collective, silent performance.
works.description_zh: 在伯明翰的 Curzon Park，Fulton 带领一次集体行走，参与者沿设定的线路缓慢移动，把一片废弃场地变成集体的、沉默的表演。
works.idea_en: A simple shared rule for walking becomes the artwork; an AR score can guide groups through a site in the same way.
works.idea_zh: 一条简单的共同行走规则就是作品本身；AR“乐谱”也可以用同样的方式引导群体穿越场地。
works.technique: Participants follow spoken instructions (walk slowly, in silence, along parallel lines), with no objects left behind.
works.technique_zh: 参与者遵循口头指令（缓慢、沉默地沿平行线行走），不留下任何物品。
works.exercise_en: Write an AR walking score where each participant sees a personal line on the ground and a speed indicator, and all lines converge at one point. Twist: the lines only appear while the walker keeps below a set speed.
works.exercise_zh: 编写一份 AR 行走乐谱：每位参与者在地面上看到一条属于自己的线和一个速度指示，所有线最终汇聚于一点；变体：只有当行走者保持在设定速度以下时，线才会出现。

works.title: A Year in a Catalan Forest
works.description: On the edge of La Garriga in Spain, Byles spends a year building large sculptures in the forest from fallen branches and found materials, leaving them for walkers to discover and for nature to reclaim.
works.description_zh: 在西班牙拉加里加的边缘，Byles 花一年时间用倒下的树枝和拾得材料在森林中建造大型雕塑，留给步行者发现，也留给自然回收。
works.idea_en: Works hidden off the path reward exploration, like geo-anchored AR pieces placed away from main routes.
works.idea_zh: 藏在路旁的作品奖励探索，就像放在主路之外的地理锚定 AR 作品。
works.technique: Branches, vines and wood are woven and balanced into large forms using only what is found on site.
works.technique_zh: 只用现场找到的材料，把树枝、藤蔓和木头编织、平衡成大型形体。
works.exercise_en: Hide three AR sculptures made from scanned forest materials at least 20 metres off a trail, with only a vague hint to find them. Twist: each sculpture slowly decays after it has been found.
works.exercise_zh: 把三件由扫描林地材料制作的 AR 雕塑藏在距小径至少 20 米的地方，只给出模糊提示；变体：每件雕塑被发现后都会慢慢腐朽。

works.title: Transience
works.description: A film of Shilling's nature art from 2008 to 2018: leaves sorted into colour gradients, balanced stones, ice circles and spirals made in woods and streams, some with stone balancer Michael Grab.
works.description_zh: 一部记录 Shilling 2008 至 2018 年自然艺术的影片：按色彩渐变排列的树叶、平衡的石头、在林中和溪流里做出的冰环和螺旋，部分作品与平衡石艺术家 Michael Grab 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Sorting found things by colour instantly makes them look designed, a fast exercise that translates directly to AR collecting and arranging.
works.idea_zh: 按颜色排列拾得之物，会让它们立刻显得“被设计过”，这是一个能直接转译为 AR 收集与排列的快速练习。
works.technique: Materials are collected on site and arranged by hand, often photographed at each stage for stop-motion.
works.technique_zh: 材料在现场收集并用手摆放，常常在每个阶段拍照以制作定格动画。
works.exercise_en: Photograph 20 leaves or objects outdoors, cut them out with segmentation, and arrange them in AR into a colour gradient spiral on the ground. Twist: the spiral re-sorts itself when a new object is added.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外拍摄 20 片叶子或物件，用分割抠出后，在 AR 中把它们在地面上排成色彩渐变的螺旋；变体：加入新物件时，螺旋会自动重新排序。

works.title: Sculpt the World
works.description: A short film of Foreman's beach works over several years: stones sorted by size and colour into spirals, circles and gradients on Welsh beaches, before the tide returns.
works.description_zh: 一部汇集 Foreman 多年海滩作品的短片：在威尔士海滩上，把石头按大小和颜色排成螺旋、圆圈和渐变，赶在潮水回来之前完成。
works.idea_en: Imposing a simple order (size, colour) on natural material reads immediately as intention, useful for AR layout and generative placement.
works.idea_zh: 给自然材料施加简单的秩序（大小、颜色）会立即被读作意图，这对 AR 布局与生成式摆放很有用。
works.technique: Stones are gathered and placed by hand following a sketched geometry, working within one low tide.
works.technique_zh: 在一次低潮的时间里，依据草图几何手工收集和摆放石头。
works.exercise_en: Scan 30 real stones and write a script that places them in AR in a spiral sorted from smallest to largest on any detected floor. Twist: the user can switch the sorting rule (size, colour, roughness) live.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描 30 块真实石头，编写脚本在任意检测到的地面上用 AR 把它们按从小到大的顺序排成螺旋；变体：用户可以实时切换排序规则（大小、颜色、粗糙度）。

works.title: Narcissus Garden
works.description: Hundreds of mirrored steel spheres float on a pond or lie across a lawn, each reflecting the sky, the trees, the other spheres and the viewer; first shown at the 1966 Venice Biennale, here at Inhotim in Brazil (2009).
works.description_zh: 数百个镜面不锈钢球漂浮在池塘上或散落在草坪上，每个都映出天空、树木、其他球体和观者；1966 年首次在威尼斯双年展展出，视频为 2009 年巴西 Inhotim 的版本。
works.idea_en: Many small mirrors scattered over a landscape multiply it into countless tiny worlds, a direct recipe for instanced reflective AR objects.
works.idea_zh: 散布在风景中的许多小镜子把风景倍增成无数个微小世界，是实例化反射 AR 物体的直接配方。
works.technique: Mass-produced polished spheres are laid out loosely on water or grass, where wind and currents move them into new clusters.
works.technique_zh: 批量生产的抛光球体松散地铺在水面或草地上，风和水流把它们推成新的聚落。
works.exercise_en: Scatter 300 instanced AR spheres with a real-time reflection probe over a lawn or pond and let the device's motion act as wind that drifts them. Twist: each sphere shows the reflection from where it was placed, not where it is now.
works.exercise_zh: 在草坪或池塘上散布 300 个带实时反射探针的实例化 AR 球体，把设备晃动当作风让它们漂移；变体：每个球体显示的是它最初被放置位置的倒影，而不是现在所在位置的倒影。

works.title: Breathing Flower
works.description: A giant red lotus inflatable, about nine metres across, slowly opens and closes its petals as if breathing, in plazas from Perth to San Francisco's Civic Center.
works.description_zh: 一朵直径约九米的巨型红色充气莲花缓缓开合花瓣，仿佛在呼吸，出现在从珀斯到旧金山市政中心的各个广场上。
works.idea_en: One slow looping motion gives an object life, a minimal animation principle for AR sculptures.
works.idea_zh: 一个缓慢循环的动作就能赋予物体生命，这是 AR 雕塑的极简动画原则。
works.technique: Fans inflate and deflate the petals in a timed cycle.
works.technique_zh: 风扇按设定周期为花瓣充气和放气。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR flower in a plaza that breathes in sync with the real breathing of the nearest user (microphone). Twist: when many people breathe slowly together, the flower blooms fully.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放置一朵巨型 AR 花，让它与最近的用户的真实呼吸（麦克风）同步“呼吸”；变体：当许多人一起慢慢呼吸时，花会完全绽放。

works.title: The Tarot Garden
works.description: On a Tuscan hillside at Garavicchio, Niki de Saint Phalle spent almost 20 years building 22 monumental figures of the tarot's Major Arcana covered in mirror, glass and ceramic mosaic, some of them inhabitable.
works.description_zh: 在托斯卡纳加拉维基奥的一处山坡上，Niki de Saint Phalle 花了近 20 年建造了 22 座对应塔罗大阿卡纳的巨型人像，覆满镜子、玻璃和陶瓷马赛克，其中有些可以居住。
works.idea_en: A walkable set of characters from one symbolic system turns a landscape into a story you move through, a model for AR theme trails.
works.idea_zh: 一整套出自同一象征体系、可以漫步其间的角色，把风景变成一个可以穿行的故事，是 AR 主题路线的范本。
works.technique: Steel armatures were sprayed with concrete and covered by hand in mirror and ceramic mosaic.
works.technique_zh: 钢骨架上喷涂混凝土，再手工覆盖镜面和陶瓷马赛克。
works.exercise_en: Choose a card set (tarot, zodiac, a local deck) and place each card's character as an AR figure along a park trail. Twist: each visitor draws a random card and the path reorders around it.
works.exercise_zh: 选择一套牌（塔罗、星座或本地纸牌），把每张牌的角色作为 AR 人物放在公园小径沿线；变体：每位访客随机抽一张牌，路线会围绕这张牌重新排列。

works.title: Maman
works.description: A spider more than nine metres tall, carrying a sac of marble eggs, stands on long thin legs over plazas in Bilbao, Ottawa, Tokyo and Seoul; visitors walk underneath it.
works.description_zh: 一只高逾九米、腹下挂着大理石卵囊的蜘蛛以细长的腿站在毕尔巴鄂、渥太华、东京和首尔的广场上；观众从它下面走过。
works.idea_en: A giant creature you can walk under creates awe and a feeling of being protected, a scale relationship AR creatures can reproduce.
works.idea_zh: 一只可以从下面走过的巨型生物带来敬畏和被守护的感觉，AR 生物可以复现这种尺度关系。
works.technique: Cast bronze and steel legs support a body with a mesh sac holding marble eggs.
works.technique_zh: 铸造的青铜与钢制腿支撑着身体，网状囊中装有大理石卵。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR creature with long legs over a courtyard so people can walk beneath it, and add soft footsteps that respond to their movement. Twist: the creature slowly steps to stay over the largest group of people.
works.exercise_zh: 在庭院上方放一只长腿的巨型 AR 生物，让人们可以从下面走过，并加入随人移动而响应的轻柔脚步声；变体：生物会慢慢挪步，始终停在人最多的那一群上方。

works.title: Puppy
works.description: A 12-metre West Highland terrier covered in tens of thousands of living flowering plants guards the entrance of the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao; the flowers are replanted twice a year.
works.description_zh: 一只高 12 米、覆满数万株活开花植物的西高地白㹴守在毕尔巴鄂古根海姆美术馆的入口；花卉每年更换两次。
works.idea_en: A giant cute figure with a living, changing skin shows how an AR object's surface can follow seasons.
works.idea_zh: 一个表皮有生命且会变化的巨大可爱形象，说明 AR 物体的表面可以跟随季节。
works.technique: A steel armature holds soil and an internal irrigation system; flowers are planted in pockets over its surface.
works.technique_zh: 钢骨架承载土壤和内部灌溉系统；花卉种植在表面的种植袋中。
works.exercise_en: Place a giant AR animal on a plaza whose surface is covered with flowers that change by month using a seasonal flower list. Twist: users can plant a flower on it and see it grow over the week.
works.exercise_zh: 在广场上放一只巨型 AR 动物，其表面覆盖的花卉按照季节花卉列表逐月变化；变体：用户可以在它身上种一朵花，并在一周内看着它长大。

works.title: Nelson's Ship in a Bottle
works.description: A 1:30 scale model of Nelson's flagship HMS Victory with sails of Dutch wax-print fabric sits in a giant glass bottle on the Fourth Plinth of Trafalgar Square, facing Nelson's Column.
works.description_zh: 一艘按 1:30 比例制作、以荷兰蜡染布为帆的纳尔逊旗舰胜利号模型装在一个巨大的玻璃瓶中，放在特拉法加广场“第四基座”上，面对纳尔逊纪念柱。
works.idea_en: An answer placed on a plinth beside an old monument rewrites the square's story, the way AR counter-monuments can.
works.idea_zh: 放在旧纪念碑旁基座上的一个回应，重写了广场的故事，AR 反纪念碑也可以这样做。
works.technique: A detailed ship model was built with printed-fabric sails and sealed in a large acrylic bottle.
works.technique_zh: 精细的船模配以印花布帆，封装在一个巨大的亚克力瓶中。
works.exercise_en: Find a monument near you and place an AR object on an empty plinth or ledge nearby that answers its story from another viewpoint. Twist: visitors vote each week on which answer stays.
works.exercise_zh: 找到你附近的一座纪念碑，在旁边空着的基座或台面上放一个从另一视角回应其故事的 AR 物体；变体：访客每周投票决定保留哪一个回应。

works.title: Tree Huts
works.description: In Berlin and other cities, Kawamata attaches small huts of scrap wood high in trees and on building corners, as if informal shelters were growing on the city.
works.description_zh: 在柏林等城市，Kawamata 把用废木料搭成的小屋高高地附着在树上和建筑转角处，仿佛非正式的庇护所正在城市上生长。
works.idea_en: Small structures attached to real surfaces at unexpected heights are a physical preview of facade-anchored AR content.
works.idea_zh: 在意想不到的高度附着于真实表面的小结构，是锚定在立面上的 AR 内容的实体预演。
works.technique: Huts are built from salvaged boards and fixed with brackets and ropes to trees and walls without damaging them.
works.technique_zh: 小屋用回收木板搭成，用支架和绳索固定在树和墙上，而不损伤它们。
works.exercise_en: Anchor five small AR huts to the corners and trees of real buildings using vertical plane detection, each containing a tiny scene. Twist: new huts appear wherever people linger longest.
works.exercise_zh: 用竖直平面检测把五座小型 AR 小屋锚定在真实建筑的转角和树上，每座里面都有一个小场景；变体：人们停留最久的地方会长出新的小屋。

works.title: De Groene Kathedraal (The Green Cathedral)
works.description: In Almere, Flevoland, 178 Lombardy poplars are planted along the ground plan of Reims Cathedral, so the trees form the columns and nave of a living church; beside it, a clearing in the forest shows the same plan as a void.
works.description_zh: 在弗莱福兰省阿尔默勒，178 棵伦巴第杨树按照兰斯大教堂的平面图种植，树木构成一座活教堂的立柱与中殿；旁边的森林中还有一片以同样平面图留出的空地。
works.idea_en: An invisible building drawn with trees is exactly an architectural overlay on land, and its 'negative' twin shows the same plan by subtraction.
works.idea_zh: 用树“画”出的看不见的建筑，正是土地上的建筑叠加，而它的“负片”双胞胎用减法呈现同一平面。
works.technique: Trees were planted at the positions of the cathedral's columns; a nearby grove was cut to leave the same plan open.
works.technique_zh: 在教堂立柱的位置种下树木；附近一片树林被伐出同样的平面。
works.exercise_en: Take the floor plan of a famous building and place its columns as AR trees at 1:1 scale on a field. Twist: toggle between 'trees as columns' and 'empty plan cut from a forest'.
works.exercise_zh: 取一座著名建筑的平面图，把它的立柱以 1:1 比例作为 AR 树种在操场上；变体：在“树作立柱”与“从森林中切出的空平面”两种模式间切换。

works.title: Grass photographs
works.description: Ackroyd & Harvey grow grass on vertical walls and project a photographic negative onto it; where more light falls, the grass makes more chlorophyll, so a portrait appears in shades of green and yellow.
works.description_zh: Ackroyd & Harvey 在竖直墙面上种草，并把照片底片投射到草上；光照越多的地方，草产生的叶绿素越多，于是一幅由绿黄深浅构成的肖像便显现出来。
works.idea_en: Light as a slow printer on a living surface shows projection as a biological process, a poetic ancestor of projection AR.
works.idea_zh: 光在活表面上缓慢打印，展示了作为生物过程的投影，是投影 AR 的诗意祖先。
works.technique: Seedling grass grown on a vertical clay surface is exposed for days to a projected negative image, and chlorophyll develops according to light intensity.
works.technique_zh: 在竖直黏土表面上培育的草苗接受数天的负片投影曝光，叶绿素按光强生成。
works.exercise_en: Project a black-and-white portrait onto a tray of cress for a week using a cheap projector, then photograph the result; build an AR version that 'grows' a portrait on a real lawn. Twist: the AR portrait fades when the real weather is cloudy.
works.exercise_zh: 用廉价投影仪把一张黑白肖像投到一盘水芹上一周并拍摄结果；再做一个 AR 版本，在真实草坪上“长”出一幅肖像；变体：当真实天气阴天时，AR 肖像会淡去。

works.title: Floating and scattering installations
works.description: Konrads builds site-specific works in forests and gardens where piles of stones seem to hover, fences break apart into flying sticks and gates dissolve into the air.
works.description_zh: Konrads 在森林和花园中创作场域作品：一堆堆石头仿佛悬浮，栅栏裂成飞散的木棍，大门消散在空气中。
works.idea_en: Natural objects frozen mid-explosion look like a paused physics simulation, an easy bridge to AR physics effects.
works.idea_zh: 在爆炸中途被凝固的自然物，看起来像暂停的物理模拟，是通往 AR 物理效果的便捷桥梁。
works.technique: Stones and sticks are held on thin hidden rods or wires so they appear suspended in mid-air.
works.technique_zh: 石头和木棍被细细的隐藏杆或线固定，看起来悬浮在半空中。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real pile of stones or a fence and, in AR, freeze it in mid-explosion using a physics simulation paused at one frame. Twist: let the user scrub time forward and backward to reassemble it.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一堆真实的石头或一段栅栏，在 AR 中用暂停在某一帧的物理模拟把它凝固在爆炸中途；变体：让用户前后拖动时间，把它重新组合起来。

works.title: Tree of 40 Fruit
works.description: By grafting, Van Aken makes single trees that bear up to 40 kinds of stone fruit; in spring they blossom in patches of pink, white and crimson, and the trees are planted in public places across the US.
works.description_zh: 通过嫁接，Van Aken 让一棵树结出多达 40 种核果；春天它们开出一片片粉、白、深红的花，这些树被种在美国各地的公共场所。
works.idea_en: An artwork that reveals its design only in one season and keeps an archive of lost varieties alive shows how living data can be an artwork.
works.idea_zh: 一件只在某个季节显露设计、同时保存着消失品种档案的作品，说明活的数据本身就可以是艺术。
works.technique: Buds of different varieties are grafted onto the branches of a host tree over several years following a planned map.
works.technique_zh: 按照预先规划的图谱，在数年间把不同品种的芽嫁接到宿主树的枝条上。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR tree in a courtyard whose branches blossom in different colours, each linked to a local heirloom variety with its story. Twist: the blossoms appear only during the real flowering week in your region.
works.exercise_zh: 在庭院里放一棵 AR 树，其枝条开出不同颜色的花，每种都链接一个本地传统品种及其故事；变体：花朵只在你所在地区真实的花期那一周出现。

works.title: Bird Watching (small brains series)
works.description: Ordinary footage of birds at a feeder and in flocks is processed so each bird leaves a trail, turning a backyard into swirling drawings of flight.
works.description_zh: 喂鸟器旁和鸟群的普通视频经过处理，让每只鸟留下一条轨迹，把后院变成飞行的旋转绘画。
works.idea_en: A cheap camera plus frame accumulation reveals hidden patterns of motion: the simplest version of an AR trail effect.
works.idea_zh: 一台廉价相机加上帧累积就能揭示隐藏的运动图案：这是 AR 轨迹效果最简单的版本。
works.technique: Clips from a Flip camera are unpacked into frames and processed in After Effects with echo and tonal effects so moving birds leave trails.
works.technique_zh: Flip 相机拍摄的片段被拆成单帧，在 After Effects 中用回声与色调效果处理，让移动的鸟留下轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Write a WebGL camera shader that blends each new frame with the last 60 frames using a 'darken' blend, and film birds, traffic or people. Twist: make trails longer for faster movers.
works.exercise_zh: 编写一个 WebGL 相机着色器，用“变暗”混合把每一帧与之前 60 帧叠加，然后拍摄鸟、车流或人群；变体：移动越快的物体，轨迹越长。

works.title: Micromigrations
works.description: An Atlantic short on Hlynsky's work, in which the paths of flies, starlings and crows are traced digitally so their hidden patterns of movement become ethereal illustrations.
works.description_zh: 《大西洋月刊》关于 Hlynsky 作品的短片：苍蝇、椋鸟和乌鸦的路径被数字化描绘，使其隐藏的运动图案变成空灵的插画。
works.idea_en: The same trace method works at many scales, from insects to flocks, so a single AR effect can reveal many kinds of motion in nature.
works.idea_zh: 同样的轨迹方法适用于从昆虫到鸟群的多种尺度，所以一个 AR 效果就能揭示自然中多种运动。
works.technique: Video frames are composited so each animal's position over time accumulates into a line, with contrast adjusted to isolate them.
works.technique_zh: 视频帧被合成，使每只动物随时间变化的位置累积成线，并调整对比度把它们分离出来。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone camera trail effect to record five different moving things outdoors (insects, leaves, birds, people, cars) and compare their trace shapes. Twist: guess the source from the trace alone.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机相机轨迹特效在户外记录五种不同的运动物体（昆虫、树叶、鸟、人、车），比较它们的轨迹形状；变体：只看轨迹来猜测来源。

works.title: Motion Exposure: whitewater kayak
works.description: In the Elora Gorge in Ontario, LED sticks mounted on a kayak paddle change colour over time while a long exposure records the paddle's path over the whitewater.
works.description_zh: 在安大略省埃洛拉峡谷，装在皮划艇桨上的 LED 灯棒随时间变色，长曝光记录下船桨在激流上方的轨迹。
works.idea_en: Colour-coding time along a motion path turns one stroke into a readable diagram, a visual grammar for AR motion trails.
works.idea_zh: 沿运动路径用颜色编码时间，把一次划桨变成可读的图示，这是 AR 运动轨迹的视觉语法。
works.technique: Programmable LED strips attached to the paddle cycle through colours on a timer during a long camera exposure at night or dusk.
works.technique_zh: 固定在船桨上的可编程 LED 灯带在夜间或黄昏的长曝光中按计时循环变色。
works.exercise_en: Track the phone or a hand with AR and draw its path in a colour that changes every second, then freeze the result as a 3D sculpture. Twist: record a sports movement (a throw, a swing) and compare two people's traces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 追踪手机或手，画出颜色每秒变化的路径，并把结果凝固成一件三维雕塑；变体：记录一个运动动作（投掷、挥拍），比较两个人的轨迹。

leads.name: Nils-Udo
leads.why: German pioneer of nature art (nests, leaf rafts, flower paintings in landscape); only weak third-party videos found.

leads.name: Susumu Shingu
leads.why: Japanese wind sculptor (Wind Caravan, Wind Museum); makes wind visible in landscapes; only short fan clips found.

leads.name: Heather Hansen
leads.why: Emptied Gestures: charcoal drawings made by her whole body's motion; own YouTube channel exists (C4oBc-o1npg), a trace/performance piece rather than landscape.

leads.name: James Brunt
leads.why: UK land artist making large stone and leaf mandalas in parks; several videos (e.g. EBdxm2DOKFs).

leads.name: Julien Berthier
leads.why: French artist of the half-sunk boat Love Love and a rock-camouflaged boat; illusion in landscape.

leads.name: Jeppe Hein
leads.why: Modified Social Benches and mirror labyrinths in parks; possible overlap with an illusion batch.

leads.name: Studio Roosegaarde — Waterlicht / Spark
leads.why: Virtual flood of light over landscapes and biodegradable fireworks; left for the light/sky batch.

leads.name: Olafur Eliasson — Green River
leads.why: 1998–2001 dyeing of rivers green in several cities; no playable video found.

leads.name: Filthy Luker
leads.why: Inflatable tentacles and eyes bursting from buildings (Art Is Everywhere); YouTube search returned only unrelated uploads.

leads.name: Spencer Tunick
leads.why: Mass nude installations in landscapes and cities; relevant as bodies placed in place but sensitive content, skipped.

leads.name: Michael Grab (Gravity Glue)
leads.why: Stone balancing in rivers; collaborator of Richard Shilling; own YouTube channel.

leads.name: Lyman Whitaker
leads.why: Wind sculptures in desert landscapes (Sedona); lead also in related-kinetic.

leads.name: Martin Hill and Philippa Jones
leads.why: New Zealand ephemeral land art made from ice, leaves and stone, photographed in wilderness.

leads.name: Mark Dion
leads.why: Ecological installations and follies in parks (Neukom Vivarium); nature as museum.

leads.name: Pinar Yoldas / Superflex (One Two Three Swing!)
leads.why: Public installations turning parks into play; Superflex's giant swings along the landscape.
